function f1NearTower(){const p=APT_INTERACTIONS['APT-TOWER'];return PlayerProfile.mode==='walk'&&Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-p.x,PlayerPed.y-p.y)<=75}
function f1StartMission(d){
 if(!f1NearTower())return toast('גש ברגל למגדל הפיקוח ולחץ F');
 PlayerProfile.activeMission={id:d.id,stage:'runway-observation',reward:d.reward,timeRemaining:d.timeLimit,startedAt:iso(),startCollisions:PlayerCar.collisions||0,returnVehicle:null,f1:{index:0,errors:0,lastCapture:null,pending:null,observations:[]}};
 setNavigationTarget('APT-TOWER',{mission:true,silent:true});SaveManager.save('mission-start',{backup:true,silent:true});openPoiPhone('business','APT-TOWER');toast('צלם שלוש תצפיות וקרא את אישורי המסלול');return true;
}
function f1Capture(){
 const m=PlayerProfile.activeMission;if(m?.id!=='M-F1-WATCH'||!f1NearTower())return false;const a=m.f1,s=f1Snapshot();
 if(!APT_OPS.ready||!AO.flights.some(f=>!f.heli&&!f.never))return toast('התנועה מתכוננת · צלם תצפית בעוד כמה רגעים');
 if(a.pending)return false;if(a.lastCapture!=null&&s.time-a.lastCapture<8)return toast('המתן לתצפית הבאה · '+Math.ceil(8-s.time+a.lastCapture)+' שנ׳');
 let prompt,options,expected;if(a.index===0){prompt='למי המסלול שמור בתצפית הזו?';expected=s.owner||'none';const codes=[...new Set([s.owner,...AO.flights.filter(f=>!f.heli&&!f.never).map(f=>f.code)].filter(Boolean))].slice(0,3);options=[{value:'none',label:'המסלול פנוי'},...codes.map(value=>({value,label:value}))];}
 else if(a.index===1){prompt='מהו מצב כניסת A2 בתצפית?';expected=s.stopBarRed?'hold':'clear';options=[{value:'hold',label:'עצור — הכניסה חסומה'},{value:'clear',label:'אישור למטוס בכניסה בלבד'}];}
 else{prompt='איזה שימוש במסלול משתקף בתצפית?';expected=s.phase;options=Object.entries(F1_PHASE_LABELS).map(([value,label])=>({value,label}));}
 a.pending={time:s.time,prompt,options,expected,owner:s.owner,stopBarRed:s.stopBarRed,phase:s.phase};a.lastCapture=s.time;renderPhone();return true;
}
function f1Answer(value){
 const m=PlayerProfile.activeMission;if(m?.id!=='M-F1-WATCH'||!f1NearTower())return false;const a=m.f1,q=a.pending;if(!q||!q.options.some(o=>o.value===value))return false;
 a.pending=null;if(value!==q.expected){a.errors++;m.timeRemaining=Math.max(0,m.timeRemaining-12);toast('הקריאה לא תאמה לתצפית · צלם שוב');renderPhone();return false;}
 a.observations.push({time:q.time,owner:q.owner,phase:q.phase,stopBarRed:q.stopBarRed});a.index++;
 if(a.index===3)return missionComplete();SaveManager.save('f1-observation',{backup:false,silent:true});renderPhone();toast('התצפית אושרה · '+a.index+'/3');return true;
}
function f1UpdateMission(dt,m,d){m.timeRemaining=Math.max(0,m.timeRemaining-dt);if(m.timeRemaining<=0)return missionFail('timeout')}
function f1ResumeMission(m){m.f1||={index:0,errors:0,observations:[]};m.f1.pending=null;m.f1.lastCapture=null;setNavigationTarget('APT-TOWER',{mission:true,silent:true})}
function f1OnComplete(m,d){
 if(d.id!=='M-F1-WATCH')return;const p=PlayerProfile.worldPersistent.runwayObservations||={runs:0,bestSeconds:null,last:null},seconds=+(d.timeLimit-m.timeRemaining).toFixed(2);
 p.runs++;p.last={at:iso(),seconds,errors:m.f1.errors,observations:m.f1.observations};if(!m.f1.errors&&(p.bestSeconds==null||seconds<p.bestSeconds))p.bestSeconds=seconds;
}

function f1GeometryAudit(){
 const issues=[],r=F1_SCOPE;if(APT_RWY.x0!==4950||APT_RWY.x1!==8250||APT_RWY.cy!==-430||APT_RWY.w!==240)issues.push('runway-lock');if(APT_TWY.cy!==-68||APT_TWY.w!==120||APT_LINKS[1].id!=='A2'||APT_LINKS[1].x!==6600||APT_LINKS[1].w!==110)issues.push('taxi-link-lock');
 for(const p of [...F1_FIXTURES,...F1_SIGNS])if(p.x<6000||p.x>=7200||p.y<-850||p.y>=850||!p.frangible||p.height>1||!TurboCity.get(p.asset))issues.push(p.id+':bounds-or-asset');
 for(const p of F1_SIGNS)if(p.y<APT_Y.SS||Math.abs(p.x-6600)<75||p.v!==1)issues.push(p.id+':sign-clearance');
 for(const b of APT_BUILDINGS)if(aptOver(aptFp(b),{x:r.x,y:-850,w:r.w,h:APT_Y.LS+850}))issues.push(b.id+':building-in-strip');
 for(const t of APT_TREES)if(t.x>=6000&&t.x<7200&&t.y<850)issues.push(t.id+':tree-airside');
 for(const p of [...PARKED_CARS,...TRAFFIC_CARS,...BUS_VEHICLES])if(p.x>=6000&&p.x<7200&&p.y>=-850&&p.y<850)issues.push(p.id+':civilian-airside');
 if(!MAP_ACTIVE_IDS.has('F1')||!MAP_ACTIVE_IDS.has('F0'))issues.push('map-inactive');if(!APT_SOLIDS.some(s=>s.id==='APT-AIRFIELD'&&s.x<=6000&&s.x+s.w>=7200&&s.y<=-850))issues.push('airside-open');
 if(F1_SPACE_USES.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.w*b.h,0)!==r.w*r.h)issues.push('space-use-coverage');
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues,scope:'F1',runwayLength:1200,runwayInsetLights:20,taxiInsetLights:20,stopBarLights:9,guardLights:2,signs:2,edgeLights:APT_LIGHTS.filter(l=>l.chunk==='F1'&&['rwy-edge','twy-edge'].includes(l.kind)).length,spaceUses:F1_SPACE_USES.length,fullWingReservation:'EW · full span touching E1 or F1',activity:'M-F1-WATCH',next:'F2'};
}

function g73EmAudit(){const issues=[],E=G73_EM,A=aptReady(),bays=A.bays.filter(b=>b.zone==='EMRG'),fps=G73_EM_BUILDINGS.map(aptFp),inE=q=>q.x0>=E.x&&q.x1<=E.x+E.w&&q.y0>=E.y&&q.y1<=E.y+E.h;
 if(bays.length!==8)issues.push('bays:'+bays.length);const by={};for(const b of bays)by[b.kind]=(by[b.kind]||0)+1;if(by.ARFF!==3||by.EMS!==2||by.POL!==2||by.RES!==1)issues.push('bay-mix');
 const fl=A.fleet.filter(f=>bays.some(b=>b.id===f.bay));if(fl.length!==7+(typeof G77_CS!=='undefined'&&G77_CS.on?1:0))issues.push('fleet:'+fl.length);   // GATE-77 S7-a · p185: + the catering van (a guest)
 for(const b of bays){if(!inE(b))issues.push('bay-outside:'+b.id);for(const f of fps)if(aptOver({x:b.x0,y:b.y0,w:b.w,h:b.y1-b.y0},f))issues.push('bay-building:'+b.id);for(const c of bays)if(c!==b&&c.id<b.id&&b.x0<c.x1&&b.x1>c.x0&&b.y0<c.y1&&b.y1>c.y0)issues.push('bay-overlap:'+b.id+'/'+c.id)}
 for(const f of fps)if(!(f.x>=E.x&&f.x+f.w<=E.x+E.w&&f.y>=E.y&&f.y+f.h<=E.y+E.h))issues.push('building-outside:'+f.id);
 const A3S=G73_CONNECTORS.find(c=>c.id==='A3S'),rj=apttAcGeom('AC-RJ-01'),rjHalf=(rj.W[3]-rj.W[2])/2/APTT_WT;if(E.x<A3S.x+rjHalf+16)issues.push('a3s-wing:'+(E.x-(A3S.x+rjHalf)).toFixed(0));
 if(E.y+E.h>APT_Y.LN-24)issues.push('L-edge');if(E.x+E.w>APL_ZONES.perim.x-6)issues.push('perimeter-road');if(E.y<APT_Y.SS+120)issues.push('runway-strip');
 const lanes=[E.eastGate,E.southExit,{x:E.x,y:E.aisle[0],w:E.w,h:E.aisle[1]-E.aisle[0]}];for(const r of lanes){for(const b of bays)if(aptOver(r,{x:b.x0,y:b.y0,w:b.w,h:b.y1-b.y0}))issues.push('exit-blocked:'+b.id);for(const f of fps)if(aptOver(r,f))issues.push('exit-building:'+f.id)}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues,rect:[E.x,E.y,E.x+E.w,E.y+E.h],bays:bays.length,vehicles:fl.length,mix:by,exits:['east → perimeter road x 8352','south → L']}}
function g73EmOpsQa(minutes=30,seed=777,margin=10){   // every aircraft shape (fuselage / wing / tail / full wing) of every flight stays ≥ margin px off the compound
 aptReady();return aoSandbox(()=>{AO.keep=true;aoInit(0,seed);const T=minutes*60;for(let t=0;t<=T;t++)aoStep(t);const E=G73_EM,box=apttObb(E.x+E.w/2,E.y+E.h/2,0,[-E.w/2,E.w/2,-E.h/2,E.h/2],'X','EM');let hits=0,min=1e9;const who={};
  for(const f of AO.hist.concat(AO.flights))for(const q of f.tracks){if(q.tr.kind!=='ac')continue;for(let t=Math.max(f.t0,q.t0);t<Math.min(f.t1,q.t0+q.tr.seq.dur);t+=.5){const p=q.tr.seq.at(t-q.t0);if(!p||p[0]<E.x-420||p[1]>E.y+E.h+420)continue;const sh=[];apttShapes(q.tr,p,sh);
   for(const o of sh){const d=Math.max(o.x0-(E.x+E.w),E.x-o.x1,o.y0-(E.y+E.h),E.y-o.y1);if(d<min)min=d;if(apttObbHit(o,box,margin)){hits++;who[f.stand]=(who[f.stand]||0)+1}}}}
  return{ok:hits===0,seed,minutes,hits,who,minBoxGap:Math.round(min)}})}

const G1_EXIT=new WeakMap();
// the runway exit of an arrival (and where it goes after the link) is read from its own planned track
function g1ExitInfo(f){
 if(!f||f.heli||f.never||f.states?.[0]?.[1]!=='INBOUND')return null;
 const n=(f.tracks||[]).length,c=G1_EXIT.get(f);if(c&&c.n===n)return c.info;let info=null;
 for(const q of f.tracks||[]){if(q.tr.kind!=='ac')continue;const d=q.tr.seq.dur||0;let ex=null;
  for(let t=0;t<=d;t+=.5){const p=q.tr.seq.at(t);if(!p||p[3]>.01)continue;
   if(!ex){if(p[1]>APT_Y.RS+8&&p[1]<APT_Y.TN-4)for(const l of APT_LINKS)if(Math.abs(p[0]-l.x)<l.w/2){ex=l;break}continue}
   if(p[1]>=APT_TWY.cy-2){info={exit:ex.id,turn:p[0]<ex.x-30?'west':p[0]>ex.x+30?'east':'straight'};break}}
  if(ex&&!info)info={exit:ex.id,turn:'west'};if(info)break}
 G1_EXIT.set(f,{n,info});return info;
}
function g1ExitOf(f){return g1ExitInfo(f)?.exit||null}
function g1Snapshot(time=APT_OPS.clk){
 const slice=aoSl(time);if(G1_MONITOR.cache?.slice===slice&&G1_MONITOR.cache.bucket===AO.B.get(slice)&&G1_MONITOR.cache.flights===AO.flights)return G1_MONITOR.cache.value;
 const bucket=AO.B.get(slice)||[],owners=[...new Set(bucket.filter(s=>s.L==='R').map(s=>String(s.t).replace(/-R$/,'')))];
 const tokens=Object.fromEntries(['TW4','LNK3','J3','TW5','JG','GL'].map(k=>[k,[...new Set(bucket.filter(s=>s.L==='S'&&s.k===k).map(s=>s.t))]]));
 const aircraft=[];let vacating=null;
 for(const f of AO.flights){if(f.heli||f.never||time<f.t0||time>=f.t1)continue;const st=aoStateOf(f,time);
  for(const q of f.tracks){const p=q.tr.seq.at(time-q.t0);if(q.tr.kind==='ac'&&p&&p[0]>=7200&&p[0]<8400&&p[1]<850&&p[1]>-850)aircraft.push({code:f.code,stand:f.stand,asset:q.tr.id,state:st,x:p[0],y:p[1],heading:p[2],height:p[3]})}
  if(!vacating&&['LANDING_ROLL','VACATE_RUNWAY'].includes(st)&&g1ExitOf(f)==='A3'){let pos=null;for(const q of f.tracks){const p=q.tr.seq.at(time-q.t0);if(q.tr.kind==='ac'&&p){pos=[p[0],p[1],p[3]];break}}
   // the lead-off lights stay on until the aircraft reaches the taxiway centre line
   if(pos&&pos[1]<=APT_TWY.cy+8)vacating={code:f.code,state:st,stand:f.stand,key:f.code+'@'+f.t0,pos,turn:g1ExitInfo(f).turn}}
 }
 const ownerFlight=AO.flights.find(f=>owners.includes(f.code)),stage=ownerFlight?aoStateOf(ownerFlight,time):null;
 const phase=!owners.length?'free':['APPROACH','LANDING_RESERVED','LANDING_ROLL','VACATE_RUNWAY'].includes(stage)?'arrival':['RUNWAY_RESERVED','LINE_UP','TAKEOFF_ROLL'].includes(stage)?'departure':'reserved';
 const conflict=owners.length>1||Object.values(tokens).some(a=>a.length>1);
 // A3 is an exit: no departure ever lines up there, so the stop bar stays red unless the controller cleared one at A3
 const a3Plane=aircraft.find(a=>owners.length===1&&a.code===owners[0]&&a.height<.01&&Math.abs(a.x-7950)<125&&a.y>=APT_Y.RY&&a.y<=APT_Y.TY+6&&['RUNWAY_RESERVED','LINE_UP'].includes(a.state));   /* GATE-77 S6r · T2 · K-99: a take-off roll passing A3 is not a clearance at A3 */
 const value={time:+time.toFixed(2),owners,owner:owners[0]||null,stage,phase,tokens,conflict,stopBarRed:conflict||!a3Plane,clearanceCode:!conflict&&a3Plane?a3Plane.code:null,leadOff:!!vacating&&!conflict,vacating,aircraft,
  onRunwayEnd:aircraft.filter(a=>a.y>=APT_Y.RN&&a.y<=APT_Y.RS&&a.height<.01).length};
 G1_MONITOR.cache={slice,bucket:AO.B.get(slice),flights:AO.flights,value};return value;
}
function g1Watch(time){
 if(time-G1_MONITOR.lastAt<.5)return;G1_MONITOR.lastAt=time;G1_MONITOR.cache=null;
 const s=g1Snapshot(time);
 if(s.vacating&&!G1_MONITOR.seen.has(s.vacating.key)){if(G1_MONITOR.seen.size>500)G1_MONITOR.seen.clear();G1_MONITOR.seen.add(s.vacating.key);G1_MONITOR.a3Vacates++;G1_MONITOR.lastVacate={code:s.vacating.code,stand:s.vacating.stand,at:+time.toFixed(1)};Dbg.event('airport-g1','a3-vacate',{code:s.vacating.code,stand:s.vacating.stand})}
 const key=[s.owner,s.phase,s.stopBarRed,s.leadOff,s.conflict].join('|');if(key===G1_MONITOR.key)return;
 G1_MONITOR.key=key;G1_MONITOR.changes++;if(s.conflict)G1_MONITOR.conflicts++;Dbg.event('airport-g1','runway-end',{owner:s.owner,phase:s.phase,stopBarRed:s.stopBarRed,leadOff:s.leadOff,conflict:s.conflict});
}
function g1Reset(){Object.assign(G1_MONITOR,{lastAt:-1,key:null,changes:0,conflicts:0,a3Vacates:0,lastVacate:null,seen:new Set(),cache:null})}

function g1Box(o){const I=TurboCity.info(o.asset,{scale:o.scale,rot:o.rot||0,variant:o.v||0});return{x:o.x-I.w/2+I.fp[0],y:o.y-I.h/2+I.fp[1],w:I.fp[2],h:I.fp[3]}}
function g1GeometryAudit(){
 const issues=[],r=G1_SCOPE,R=APT_RWY,T=APT_TWY,A3=APT_LINKS[2];
 if(R.x0!==4950||R.x1!==8250||R.cy!==-430||R.w!==240)issues.push('runway-lock');if(T.cy!==-68||T.w!==120||T.x1!==8030)issues.push('taxi-lock');
 if(A3?.id!=='A3'||A3.x!==7950||A3.w!==110)issues.push('a3-lock');
 const inG1=p=>p.x>=r.x&&p.x<r.x+r.w&&p.y>=-850&&p.y<r.h;
 for(const p of [...G1_FIXTURES,...G1_LEADOFF,...G1_SIGNS,G1_PAPI,G1_WINDSOCK,G1_ARFF.sign])if(!inG1(p)||!p.frangible||p.height>1||!TurboCity.get(p.asset))issues.push(p.id+':bounds-or-asset');
 for(const p of G1_SIGNS)if(p.y<APT_Y.SS||Math.abs(p.x-A3.x)<A3.w/2+20)issues.push(p.id+':sign-clearance');
 const link={x:A3.x-A3.w/2,y:A3.y0-2,w:A3.w,h:A3.y1-A3.y0+6},twy={x:T.x0-40,y:T.cy-T.w/2,w:T.x1-T.x0+80,h:T.w},rwy={x:R.x0,y:R.cy-R.w/2,w:R.x1-R.x0,h:R.w},blast={x:R.x1,y:R.cy-R.w/2,w:90,h:R.w};
 const papi=g1Box(G1_PAPI);if(aptOver(papi,link)||aptOver(papi,twy)||aptOver(papi,rwy))issues.push('papi-on-pavement');
 if(G1_PAPI.x<R.x1-460||G1_PAPI.x>R.x1-400)issues.push('papi-not-abeam-aiming-point-27');
 const ws=g1Box(G1_WINDSOCK);if(aptOver(ws,link)||aptOver(ws,rwy)||aptOver(ws,twy))issues.push('windsock-on-pavement');
 const loc={x:G1_LOC.pad.x,y:G1_LOC.pad.y,w:G1_LOC.pad.w,h:G1_LOC.pad.h};if(aptOver(loc,rwy)||aptOver(loc,blast)||loc.x+loc.w>8400||Math.abs((G1_LOC.y0+G1_LOC.y1)/2-R.cy)>1)issues.push('loc-placement');
 const road={x:G1_ARFF.x,y:G1_ARFF.y0,w:G1_ARFF.w,h:G1_ARFF.y1-G1_ARFF.y0},P=APL.zones.perim;
 if(aptOver(road,rwy)||aptOver(road,blast)||aptOver(road,loc))issues.push('arff-road-on-runway');if(road.x<P.x-1||road.x+road.w>P.x+P.w+1)issues.push('arff-road-off-perimeter-zone');
 if(G1_ARFF.stopY<APT_Y.SS||G1_ARFF.stopY>APT_Y.SS+20)issues.push('arff-stop-line');
 const vault=g1Box(G1_AFL);const heliApron={x:8060,y:640,w:300,h:100};
 if(vault.y<APT_Y.SS||aptOver(vault,twy)||aptOver(vault,heliApron)||aptOver(vault,road)||aptOver(vault,link))issues.push('afl-clearance');
 for(const h of APT_HELIPADS)if(Math.hypot(Math.max(vault.x-h.x,0,h.x-vault.x-vault.w),Math.max(vault.y-h.y,0,h.y-vault.y-vault.h))<h.r+10)issues.push('afl-near-helipad-'+h.id);
 if(vault.y+vault.h>APL.zones.eBlock.y)issues.push('afl-in-east-block');
 for(const o of G1_LEADOFF)if(Math.hypot(o.x-A3.x,0)>110||o.y<APT_Y.RY-5||o.y>APT_Y.TY+4)issues.push(o.id+':lead-off-corridor');
 for(const b of APT_BUILDINGS)if(!b.emrg&&aptOver(aptFp(b),{x:r.x,y:-850,w:r.w,h:600+850}))issues.push(b.id+':building-in-runway-row');   // S4: the emergency compound has its own clearance audit (g73EmAudit / g73EmOpsQa)
 for(const t of APT_TREES)if(t.x>=r.x&&t.x<r.x+r.w&&t.y<r.h)issues.push(t.id+':tree-airside');
 for(const p of [...PARKED_CARS,...TRAFFIC_CARS,...BUS_VEHICLES])if(p.x>=r.x&&p.x<r.x+r.w&&p.y>=-850&&p.y<r.h)issues.push(p.id+':civilian-airside');
 if(!MAP_ACTIVE_IDS.has('G1')||!MAP_ACTIVE_IDS.has('G0'))issues.push('map-inactive');if(!APT_SOLIDS.some(s=>s.id==='APT-AIRFIELD'&&s.x<=r.x&&s.x+s.w>=r.x+r.w&&s.y<=-850&&s.y+s.h>=r.h))issues.push('airside-open');
 if(G1_SPACE_USES.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.w*b.h,0)!==r.w*r.h)issues.push('space-use-coverage');
 for(const a of G1_SPACE_USES)for(const b of G1_SPACE_USES)if(a!==b&&a.id<b.id&&aptOver(a,b))issues.push('space-use-overlap '+a.id+'/'+b.id);
 const env=aptFullWingEnvelope({W:[-80,80,-6,6]},7950,(APT_Y.RS+APT_Y.TN)/2,0,'qa');if(!env)issues.push('wing-envelope-not-in-G1');
 const edges=APT_LIGHTS.filter(l=>l.chunk==='G1'&&l.kind==='rwy-edge');
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues,scope:'G1',gate:'GATE-68',runwayEastLength:R.x1-r.x,blastPad:90,thresholdLights:12,runwayEndLights:12,centreLineLights:G1_FIXTURES.filter(l=>l.role==='runway-inset').length,
  taxiCentreLights:G1_FIXTURES.filter(l=>l.role==='taxi-inset').length,stopBarLights:9,guardLights:2,leadOffLights:G1_LEADOFF.length,signs:G1_SIGNS.length,runwayEdgeLights:edges.length,cautionAmberEdge:edges.filter(l=>l.v===3).length,
  taxiEdgeLights:APT_LIGHTS.filter(l=>l.chunk==='G1'&&l.kind==='twy-edge').length+2,papi:'27 · '+G1_PAPI.x,windsock:1,loc09Elements:G1_LOC.n,arffAccess:road.h,afl:G1_AFL.asset,fences:G1_FENCES.length,spaceUses:G1_SPACE_USES.length,
  fullWingReservation:'EW · full span touching E1, F1 or G1',aircraftStandIds:aptReady().stands.filter(s=>s.ngx>=7200&&s.ngy<850).map(s=>s.id),next:'G2'};
}
// sandbox check: lead-off lights follow the planned exits; the A3 stop bar never opens; no token conflicts at the east end
function g1OpsQa(minutes=15,seed=777){
 if(!APTT_SPEC){APTT_SPEC=aptBuildSpec();APTT_C=aptBuildC()}
 return aoSandbox(()=>{AO.keep=true;aoInit(0,seed);const T=minutes*60;let lead=0,stopOpen=0,conflicts=0,mismatch=0,maxInG1=0;const vac=new Set(),exits={};
  for(let t=0;t<=T;t+=.5){aoStep(t);G1_MONITOR.cache=null;const s=g1Snapshot(t);if(s.leadOff){lead++;vac.add(s.vacating.key)}if(!s.stopBarRed)stopOpen++;if(s.conflict)conflicts++;maxInG1=Math.max(maxInG1,s.aircraft.length);
   // every lit lead-off belongs to an aircraft that really is on the runway or the A3 link
   if(s.leadOff){const p=s.vacating.pos;if(!p||p[2]>.01||p[1]<APT_Y.RN||p[1]>APT_TWY.cy+8||p[0]>8000)mismatch++}}
  const turns={};for(const f of AO.hist.concat(AO.flights)){const e=g1ExitInfo(f);if(e){exits[e.exit]=(exits[e.exit]||0)+1;if(e.exit==='A3')turns[e.turn]=(turns[e.turn]||0)+1}}
  G1_MONITOR.cache=null;
  return{ok:conflicts===0&&mismatch===0&&stopOpen===0&&vac.size>0,seed,minutes,a3Vacates:vac.size,leadOffSeconds:lead/2,stopBarOpenSeconds:stopOpen/2,conflicts,mismatch,maxAircraftInG1:maxInG1,exits,a3Turns:turns};
 });
}

 if(action==='remember'&&id==='APT-PAX'){const bay=APT_STALLS.find(s=>s.group==='P-PAX'&&e2InsideBay(PlayerCar,s));if(!bay||carKmh()>1)return toast('כדי לשמור מיקום, עצור את הרכב באחת מחניות הנוסעים');e2Persistent().parkingLocation={x:PlayerCar.x,y:PlayerCar.y,asset:PlayerCar.asset,slot:bay.id,at:iso()};SaveManager.save('airport-parking-location',{backup:false,silent:true});toast('מקום החניה נשמר');renderPhone();return true}
 if(action==='forget'&&id==='APT-PAX'){e2Persistent().parkingLocation=null;if(State.navigation?.targetId==='APT-MY-PARK')clearNavigation();SaveManager.save('airport-parking-clear',{backup:false,silent:true});renderPhone();return true}
 if(action==='save'){SaveManager.save('airport-landside');renderPhone();return true}return false
}
function e2CargoSnapshot(){

 return{time:+time.toFixed(1),rail:raStatus().label,stands:['C1','C2','C3'].map(id=>{const f=flights.filter(f=>f.stand===id&&f.t0<=time&&f.t1>=time).sort((a,b)=>b.t0-a.t0)[0];return{id,flight:f?.code||null,state:f?aoStateOf(f,time):'ON_BLOCK'}}),railLive:true}
}
const E2_STATE_LABELS={ON_BLOCK:'חונה',TURNAROUND_READY:'מוכן',PUSHBACK_RESERVED:'ממתין לדחיפה',PUSHBACK:'נדחף מהעמדה',TAXI_OUT:'הסעה להמראה',HOLD_SHORT:'ממתין לאישור',RUNWAY_RESERVED:'אישור מסלול',LINE_UP:'כניסה למסלול',TAKEOFF_ROLL:'המראה',DEPARTED:'יצא מהשדה',INBOUND:'ממתין לנחיתה',APPROACH:'בגישה לנחיתה',LANDING_RESERVED:'אישור נחיתה',LANDING_ROLL:'נחיתה',VACATE_RUNWAY:'פינוי מסלול',TAXI_IN:'הסעה לעמדה',STAND_RESERVED:'העמדה שמורה',GO_AROUND:'גישה חוזרת'};
function e2PhoneCard(id){
 const held=PlayerProfile.mode==='walk'&&Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-APT_INTERACTIONS[id].x,PlayerPed.y-APT_INTERACTIONS[id].y)<=80;
 const btn=(label,action,disabled=false)=>`<button data-e2-action="${action}" ${disabled?'disabled':''}>${label}</button>`;
 if(id==='APT-RENT')return pcard('החזרת רכב',pnote('כניסה לרכב פנוי באמצעות E. להחזרה: חונים במפרץ הצהוב, יוצאים באמצעות E וניגשים לדלפק.')+`<div class="phoneActions">${btn('החזר רכב', 'return',!held||!e2RentalCandidate())}</div>`,'garage');
 if(id==='APT-PAX'){const p=PlayerProfile.worldPersistent?.airportLandside?.parkingLocation;return pcard('איתור הרכב שלי',pnote(p?'מקום החניה נשמר: '+p.slot:'עצור בחניית נוסעים ושמור את המיקום לפני היציאה.')+`<div class="phoneActions">${btn('שמור את מקום הרכב','remember',!held)}${p?'<button data-nav-target="APT-MY-PARK">נווט לרכב</button>'+btn('נקה מקום שמור','forget',!held):''}</div>`,'nav')}
 if(id==='APT-CARGO'){const s=e2CargoSnapshot();return pcard('לוח עמדות המטען',pkv(s.stands.map(q=>[q.id,q.flight?q.flight+' · '+(E2_STATE_LABELS[q.state]||'בהמתנה'):'ללא טיסה בתהליך']))+pnote('הלוח מציג את בקר השדה החי. חיבור הרכבת ועבודות השחקן נפתחים בשלבים הבאים.'),'career')}
 return raPhoneCard(id)
}
function e2GeometryAudit(){
 const issues=[],over=aptOver,inside=q=>q.x>=5400&&q.y>=850&&q.x+q.w<=6000&&q.y+q.h<=1700,road={x:5400,y:1182,w:348,h:136};   // GATE-74: the private service lane (ends at x 5748)   // S3a: the cargo reception yard east of AP-05 moved north with the cargo terminal (y 814…944)
 for(const q of [...E2_BUILDINGS.map(aptFp),...E2_PROPS.map(e2SpriteBox)]){if(!inside(q))issues.push('outside-scope');if(over(q,road))issues.push('public-road')}
 for(const p of Object.values(APT_INTERACTIONS).filter(p=>p.chunk==='E2'&&!p.phoneOnly))if(personBlockedAt(p.x,p.y,5))issues.push(p.id+':blocked-poi');
 for(const p of E2_PATHS){const a=p.pts[0],b=p.pts[1],n=Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])/8);for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const x=a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*i/n,y=a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*i/n;if(staticPersonBlockedAt(x,y,7))issues.push(p.id+':blocked-path');}}
 const cross=CROSSWALKS.filter(c=>c.signalNode==='AIR-1');if(cross.length||!CROSSWALKS.some(c=>c.signalized&&Math.hypot(c.x-5180,c.y-1600)<900))issues.push('crosswalk');   /* p521x (R-76): no crossing in the middle of the airport road (AIR-1) — the walkers of P-WEST cross at a junction */
 if(APT_STALLS.some(s=>s.x+s.w>5400))issues.push('parking-left-east');
 const ra=raAudit();if(!ra.ok)issues.push(...ra.issues.map(s=>'rail-air:'+s));
 // S3b · truck yard + reception out of the future rail corridor (x 5750–5950, north of R-AIR)
 {const cor={x:5750,y:580,w:200,h:620},fps=[...E2_BUILDINGS.map(aptFp),...E2_PROPS.map(e2SpriteBox),E2_TRUCK_YARD,E2_GATE_LANE,E2_AIR_C,...E2_TRUCK_DOCKS,...E2_CARGO_BAYS,...PARKED_CARS.filter(c=>/^PC-E2-DOCK/.test(c.id)).map(c=>c.slotRect)];for(const q of fps)if(over(q,cor))issues.push('rail-corridor:'+(q.id||'?'));
  for(const [x1,y1,x2,y2] of APT_FENCE_SEGS)if(y1===y2&&y1>=845&&y1<=1250&&Math.max(x1,x2)>5750&&Math.min(x1,x2)<5950&&!(y1===APT_FENCE_Y))issues.push('fence-in-corridor');
  const yd=E2_TRUCK_YARD;for(const q of [...E2_TRUCK_DOCKS,...E2_CARGO_BAYS,E2_GATE_LANE])if(!(q.x>=yd.x-1&&q.x+q.w<=yd.x+yd.w+1&&q.y>=yd.y-2&&q.y+q.h<=yd.y+yd.h+1))issues.push('outside-yard:'+q.id);
  for(let i=0;i<E2_TRUCK_DOCKS.length;i++)for(let j=0;j<E2_CARGO_BAYS.length;j++)if(over(E2_TRUCK_DOCKS[i],E2_CARGO_BAYS[j]))issues.push('dock-bay');
  if(!APT_FENCE_SEGS.some(f=>f[1]===APT_FENCE_Y&&f[2]===5684)||!APT_FENCE_SEGS.some(f=>f[1]===APT_FENCE_Y&&f[0]===5744))issues.push('cargo-gate');
  if(over(aptFp(aptB('APT-CARGO-GATEHOUSE')),E2_AIR_C)||over(aptFp(aptB('APT-CARGO-GATEHOUSE')),E2_GATE_LANE))issues.push('gatehouse-in-lane');
  const ac=E2_AIR_C;if(ac.y+ac.h<1204)issues.push('air-c-not-at-road');for(const l of STREET_LIGHTS)if(Math.abs(l.y-1192)<3&&l.x>ac.x-6&&l.x<ac.x+ac.w+6)issues.push('air-c-lamp:'+l.id);
  for(const c of PARKED_CARS.filter(c=>/^PC-E2-DOCK/.test(c.id)))if(!e2InsideBay(c,c.slotRect))issues.push('truck-outside-dock:'+c.id)}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:[...new Set(issues)],scope:'E2 east · Rail–Air work site + air cargo · private lane',wholeChunkDone:false,rentalMovedTo:'P-WEST-N (GATE-74)',railAir:ra.ok,cargoSortingBays:E2_CARGO_BAYS.length,truckDocks:E2_TRUCK_DOCKS.length,truckYard:[E2_TRUCK_YARD.x,E2_TRUCK_YARD.y,E2_TRUCK_YARD.x+E2_TRUCK_YARD.w,E2_TRUCK_YARD.y+E2_TRUCK_YARD.h],cargoGate:[5684,5744],entrance:'AIR-C',paths:E2_PATHS.length,props:E2_PROPS.length,visitors:E2_VISITORS.length,next:'RAIL-AIR stage 2'}
}

function a6FerryPose(time=a6FerryPersistent().clock){
 const F=A6_FERRY,z=((time%F.cycle)+F.cycle)%F.cycle,di=F.dwell+F.travel;
 let phase,u,remaining;if(z<F.dwell){phase='A6';u=0;remaining=F.dwell-z}else if(z<di){phase='outbound';u=(z-F.dwell)/F.travel;remaining=di-z}else if(z<di+F.dwell){phase='G8';u=1;remaining=di+F.dwell-z}else{phase='inbound';u=1-(z-di-F.dwell)/F.travel;remaining=F.cycle-z}
 const p=apttAt(F.path,F.path.len*u);return{x:p[0],y:p[1],heading:p[2]+(phase==='inbound'?Math.PI*apttSm(clamp(Math.min((F.path.len*(1-u)-(F.flipB||260))/180,(F.path.len*u-260)/180),0,1)):0),phase,u,remaining,time};
}
function a6FerryWait(from,time=a6FerryPersistent().clock){const F=A6_FERRY,z=((time%F.cycle)+F.cycle)%F.cycle;if(from==='A6')return z<F.dwell?0:F.cycle-z;return z>=F.dwell+F.travel&&z<F.dwell*2+F.travel?0:(F.dwell+F.travel-z+F.cycle)%F.cycle}
function a6BoardFerry(from){

}
function a6PlacePassenger(){if(!State.ferryRide)return;const p=a6FerryPose();PlayerPed.x=p.x-Math.cos(p.heading)*38;PlayerPed.y=p.y-Math.sin(p.heading)*38;PlayerPed.pose='idle';PlayerPed.moving=false;PlayerPed.heading=p.heading;PlayerPed.dir=personDirection(Math.cos(p.heading),Math.sin(p.heading));PlayerProfile.mode='walk'}

function a6Action(action,arg){

 if(action==='buy'){const list=id==='A6-CAFE'?A6_CAFE_ITEMS:A6_MARKET_ITEMS,it=list.find(q=>q[0]===arg);if(!it||PlayerProfile.money<it[2])return toast('אין מספיק כסף');PlayerProfile.money-=it[2];PlayerProfile.inventory[it[0]]=(PlayerProfile.inventory[it[0]]||0)+1;recordTransaction('a6-shop',-it[2],{item:it[0]});SaveManager.save('a6-purchase',{backup:true,silent:true});renderPhone();return true}
 if(action==='sell'&&id==='A6-MARKET'){const f=A6_FIELDS.find(f=>f.item===arg);if(!f||!(PlayerProfile.inventory[arg]>0))return false;PlayerProfile.inventory[arg]--;PlayerProfile.money+=f.price;a6FarmPersistent().sold=(a6FarmPersistent().sold||0)+1;recordTransaction('a6-produce',f.price,{item:arg});SaveManager.save('a6-sale',{backup:true,silent:true});renderPhone();return true}
 if(action==='save')return SaveManager.save('a6-manual');return false;
}

function a6GeometryAudit(){
 const issues=[],over=(a,b)=>a.x<b.x+b.w&&a.x+a.w>b.x&&a.y<b.y+b.h&&a.y+a.h>b.y;
 const roads=EDGES.filter(e=>e.globalRoadId.startsWith('TC-A6-')).map(e=>{const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],half=roadType(e).width/2+20;return{id:e.id,x:Math.min(a.x,b.x)-half,y:Math.min(a.y,b.y)-half,w:Math.abs(a.x-b.x)+half*2,h:Math.abs(a.y-b.y)+half*2}});
 for(const b of A6_BUILDINGS){if(b.fp.x<0||b.fp.x+b.fp.w>1200||b.fp.y<4250||b.fp.y+b.fp.h>4990)issues.push(b.id+':bounds');for(const r of roads)if(over(b.fp,r))issues.push(b.id+':road '+r.id);if(a6CollisionAt(b.entrance.x,b.entrance.y,5,true))issues.push(b.id+':entrance')}
 for(let i=0;i<A6_BUILDINGS.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<A6_BUILDINGS.length;j++)if(over(A6_BUILDINGS[i].fp,A6_BUILDINGS[j].fp))issues.push('building-overlap');
 for(const L of A6_LOTS){if(!A6_ACCESS.some(q=>q.lot===L.id&&over(q,L)))issues.push(L.id+':no-access');for(const r of roads)if(over(L,r))issues.push(L.id+':road');for(const b of A6_BUILDINGS)if(over(L,b.fp))issues.push(L.id+':building')}
 for(const q of A6_ACCESS){const r=roads.find(r=>r.id===q.road);if(!r||!over(q,r))issues.push(q.id+':road-gap')}
 for(const p of Object.values(A6_POIS))if(a6CollisionAt(p.x,p.y,5,true))issues.push(p.id+':blocked');
 if(!a6OnPier(A6_POIS['A6-FERRY'].x,A6_POIS['A6-FERRY'].y,5)||!a6OnPier(G8_FERRY_POI.x,G8_FERRY_POI.y,5))issues.push('boarding-off-pier');
 if(PORT_BERTHS.some(b=>b.kind==='ferry'))issues.push('ferry-still-at-port');
 if(!MAP_ACTIVE_IDS.has('A6')||!ACTIVE_REGIONS.includes(A6_REGION))issues.push('inactive');
 for(const f of A6_FIELDS)for(const r of roads)if(over(f,r))issues.push(f.id+':road');
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues,buildings:A6_BUILDINGS.length,fields:A6_FIELDS.length,parking:A6_STALLS.length,accessible:A6_STALLS.filter(s=>s.accessible).length,trees:A6_TREES.length,props:A6_PROPS.length,machines:A6_MACHINES.length,visitors:12,roads:roads.length,origin:'A6',destination:'G8',portFerries:PORT_BERTHS.filter(b=>b.kind==='ferry').length,ferryFare:A6_FERRY.fare};
}

 if(!P)throw new Error('No baggage terminal for '+sd.id);
 const n=f2BagN(code||sd.id+v.id),muDur=1.4+n*1.45,same=home&&H.id===P.id&&Math.abs(H.exitX-P.muS)<24,r1=home?(H.r1||Math.abs(H.exitX-b.x)/2):0;   // GATE-73 S2: pockets A/B park between the stands, away from their belt: drive via lane L
 const uT=(H&&H.uT)||F2_BAG.uTop-Math.max(0,(b.carts||2)-2)*24,leaveHome=home?[[b.x,b.yc,0],[b.x,uT,r1],[H.exitX,uT,r1]]:[...afBayOutList(b),[AF.GLN,AF.HW,30],[AF.GLN,L,26]];
 const toMU=same?[[P.exitX,720,9],[P.muS,758,9],[P.muS,F2_BAG.stop,0]]:[[home?H.exitX:AF.GLN,L,14],[P.muS,L,14],[P.muS,F2_BAG.stop,0]];
 const muLoop=[[P.muS,F2_BAG.stop,0],[P.muS,F2_BAG.uY,16],[P.muN,F2_BAG.uY,16]];
 const hairpin=rem?rem.hairpin:LY&&LY.hairpin?LY.hairpin:[[c1,ws,0],[c1,ws-24,12],[c3,ws-24,12],[c3,L,14]];
 const goHome=home?[[b.x,L,10],[b.x,b.yc,0]]:[[AF.GLS,L,26],[AF.GLS,AF.HE,30],...afBayIn(b)];
 const toStand=rem?rem.toStand:LY&&LY.toStand?LY.toStand:[[c1,L,14],[c1,ws,0]];
 const tag=(leg,f2)=>{leg.f2=f2;return leg};
 const base={n,code:code||null,pocket:P.id,terminal:P.terminal,door:P.door,homePocket:H?.id||'G2',mu:P.mu,cx,sd:sd.id,beltX:P.beltX,muS:P.muS,side:rem?rem.side:sv,flip:rem?rem.flip:sv,remote:!!rem};
 let legs=[],dOut=0;
 if(kind==='dep'){
  const out=afMv(LY&&LY.south&&home&&H.id==='D'?[[b.x,b.yc,0],[b.x,LY.yA,14],[LY.c1,LY.yA,16],[LY.c1,L,14],[P.muS,L,14],[P.muS,F2_BAG.stop,0]]:[...leaveHome,...toMU],vm,{th0:b.th,blend:30,v1:4});out.kind='out';tag(out,{...base,load:0});
  const e1=out.endPose(),mu=tag(apttHold(e1,muDur,'mu'),{...base,fill:'in',at:'mu'});
  const mid=afMv([...muLoop,[P.muN,L,18],...toStand],vm,{th0:e1[2],blend:28,v0:5,v1:4});mid.kind='mid';tag(mid,{...base,load:n});
  const e2=mid.endPose(),svc=tag(apttHold(e2,hold=g77BwHoldAt(v,sd,ac,hold,code,e2,kind),'svc'),{...base,fill:'out',at:'ac'});
  const back=afMv([...hairpin,...goHome],vm,{th0:e2[2],blend:34,v0:6});back.kind='back';tag(back,{...base,load:0});
  legs=[out,mu,mid,svc,back];dOut=out.dur+mu.dur+mid.dur;
 }else{
  const out=afMv(LY&&LY.south&&home&&H.id==='D'?[[b.x,b.yc,0],[b.x,LY.yA,14],...LY.toStand.slice(2)]:[...leaveHome,...(home?[[H.exitX,L,14]]:[]),...toStand],vm,{th0:b.th,blend:30,v1:5});out.kind='out';tag(out,{...base,load:0});
  const e1=out.endPose(),svc=tag(apttHold(e1,hold=g77BwHoldAt(v,sd,ac,hold,code,e1,kind),'svc'),{...base,fill:'in',at:'ac'});
  const mid=afMv([...hairpin,[P.muS,L,14],[P.muS,F2_BAG.stop,0]],vm,{th0:e1[2],blend:34,v0:6,v1:4});mid.kind='mid';tag(mid,{...base,load:n});
  const e2=mid.endPose(),mu=tag(apttHold(e2,muDur,'mu'),{...base,fill:'out',at:'mu'});
  // home pocket: straight north out of the make-up loop across lane L; the S-curve onto the bay axis ends south of the parked neighbours
  const back=afMv(same?[...muLoop,[P.muN,756,10],[b.x,728,10],[b.x,b.yc,0]]:[...muLoop,[P.muN,L,18],...goHome],vm,{th0:e2[2],blend:28,v0:5});back.kind='back';tag(back,{...base,load:0});
  legs=[out,svc,mid,mu,back];dOut=out.dur;
 }
 const trk=afTrackOf(v,legs);trk.f2bag=kind;
 return{trk,dOut,hold,dur:trk.seq.dur};
}
// ---- bag load state of a train at local task time lt (drawn per cart; one bag in flight at a time) --------------------------------
function f2BagTimes(dur,n){const step=(dur-1.2)/n,fly=Math.min(1,step*.72);return{step,fly,t0:.6}}
function f2BagState(tr,lt){
 if(!tr||!tr.seq||lt==null)return null;const q=tr.seq.legAt(lt);if(!q||!q.leg.f2)return null;const f=q.leg.f2,n=f.n;
 if(f.fill==null)return{k:f.load||0,f,leg:q.leg,t:q.t,fly:null};
 const T=f2BagTimes(q.leg.dur,n),t=q.t;let done=0,fly=null;
 for(let j=0;j<n;j++){const s=T.t0+j*T.step,e=s+T.fly;if(t>=e)done++;else if(t>=s){fly={j,u:(t-s)/T.fly}}}
 if(f.fill==='in')return{k:done,f,leg:q.leg,t,fly};
 // unloading: the bag in flight has already left the cart
 return{k:n-done-(fly?1:0),f,leg:q.leg,t,fly};
}
const F2_BAG_COLORS=['#e0583a','#2d7fd0','#f0b232','#3fa66a','#8e5bd6','#e86fa0','#39434f','#1fa3a8','#c9792f','#d9d4c6'];
function f2DrawBagsOnCart(g,k0,seed){ // in cart-local coordinates (cart hx 10 / hy 6.5), 3 × 2 slots
 for(let s=0;s<k0;s++){const col=s%3,row=s/3|0,x=-6.2+col*4.8,y=-2.6+row*5.2,c=F2_BAG_COLORS[(seed+s*3)%F2_BAG_COLORS.length];
  g.fillStyle='rgba(8,18,26,.4)';g.fillRect(x-1.6,y-1.1,4.3,3.9);g.fillStyle=c;g.fillRect(x-2.1,y-1.8,4.3,3.9);g.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.38)';g.fillRect(x-2.1,y-1.8,4.3,.9);g.fillStyle='#14181c';g.fillRect(x-.7,y-2.5,1.4,.8);g.strokeStyle='rgba(20,24,28,.6)';g.lineWidth=.4;g.strokeRect(x-2.1,y-1.8,4.3,3.9)}
}
function f2DrawFlyBag(g,x,y,u,c){const h=Math.sin(Math.PI*u)*4.5;g.save();g.fillStyle='rgba(8,18,26,.3)';g.fillRect(x-1.6,y-1,4.2,3.6);g.fillStyle=c;g.fillRect(x-2.1,y-1.9-h,4.4,4);g.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.42)';g.fillRect(x-2.1,y-1.9-h,4.4,.9);g.fillStyle='#14181c';g.fillRect(x-.7,y-2.6-h,1.4,.8);g.restore()}
// called from aptDrawVeh for vehicles with carts (patched): draws bags in the carts, the belt-loader plate at the aircraft and the bag in flight
function f2DrawTrainBags(g,a,carts,al){
 const st=f2BagState(a.tr,a.lt),seed=(st?.f?.n||0)*7;if(!st)return;   /* GATE-77P · p247: one colour per bag */
 if(G77_BW.on&&st.f.at==='ac'&&st.f.fill!=null&&g77BwDraw(g,a,carts,al,st))return;   // GATE-77 S7-a · p187 · D-184: the workers
 const k=Math.max(0,st.k|0),k0=Math.min(F2_BAG.cap,k),k1=Math.max(0,k-F2_BAG.cap);
 const svc=st.f.at==='ac'&&st.f.fill!=null;
 if(G77_MUB.on&&st.f.at==='mu'&&st.f.fill!=null&&g77MubDraw(g,carts,al,st))return;   /* p247 */
 // belt-loader plate from the cart to the hold door (local +y points at the fuselage: the train stands west of the aircraft, heading north)
 if(svc&&s6aBagCrew(st,a)){}else if(svc)for(const c of carts){g.save();g.globalAlpha=al;g.translate(c[0],c[1]);g.rotate(c[2]);if((st.f.flip??st.f.side)>0)g.scale(1,-1);g.fillStyle='rgba(8,18,26,.25)';g.fillRect(-4.2,7.6,9,16);g.fillStyle='#3e454c';g.fillRect(-4.6,6.6,9.2,16);g.fillStyle='#8a939b';for(let y=7.8;y<22;y+=2.6)g.fillRect(-4,y,8,1.1);g.restore();break}
 for(let i=0;i<carts.length;i++){const c=carts[i],kk=i===carts.length-1?Math.max(0,k-i*F2_BAG.cap):Math.max(0,Math.min(F2_BAG.cap,k-i*F2_BAG.cap));if(!kk)continue;g.save();g.globalAlpha=al;g.translate(c[0],c[1]);g.rotate(c[2]);f2DrawBagsOnCart(g,kk,seed+i*F2_BAG.cap*3);g.restore()}
 if(st.fly){const j=st.fly.j,ci=Math.floor(j/F2_BAG.cap),c=carts[Math.min(ci,carts.length-1)],slot=j%F2_BAG.cap,lx=-6.2+(slot%3)*4.8,ly=-2.6+(slot/3|0)*5.2;
  const cs=Math.cos(c[2]),sn=Math.sin(c[2]),px=c[0]+lx*cs-ly*sn,py=c[1]+lx*sn+ly*cs;
  if(st.f.at==='ac'&&s6aBagFly(st,px,py,F2_BAG_COLORS[(seed+j*3)%F2_BAG_COLORS.length]))return;   // GATE-77 S6a M3b
  const ox=st.f.at==='mu'?st.f.beltX-4:st.f.cx+13*(st.f.side||-1),oy=py;
  const from=st.f.fill==='in'?[ox,oy]:[px,py],to=st.f.fill==='in'?[px,py]:[ox,oy],u=st.fly.u;
  f2DrawFlyBag(g,from[0]+(to[0]-from[0])*u,from[1]+(to[1]-from[1])*u,u,F2_BAG_COLORS[(seed+j*3)%F2_BAG_COLORS.length])}
}

// ---- visible airside travellers: each real flight has an arrival group followed by a departure group ------------------------------
const F2_PAX_ASSETS=['PE-43','PE-44','PE-09','PE-10','PE-19','PE-04'];
function f2PaxPlan(f){
 const s=APT_STANDS.find(s=>s.id===f.stand),P=f2PocketForStand(f.stand);if(!s||!P||!f.bridgeAt)return null;
 const B=f2BridgeGeometry(s,f),start=f.bridgeAt[0]+7.4,end=f.bridgeAt[1]-.8,inbound=f.states[0]?.[1]==='INBOUND',pl=g77K72PaxLine(s,f)||[B.terminal,B.dock],travel=g2PathLen(pl)/22,gap=.92,window=end-start;
 const wanted=f.q?Math.max(f.q.paxA,f.q.paxD):12+f2BagN(f.code)%7,room=inbound?(window-4)/2:window-2,count=Math.min(wanted,Math.floor((room-travel)/gap)+1);
 if(count<1)return null;const dur=travel+(count-1)*gap,arr=inbound?{start,end:start+dur}:null,dep={start:Math.max(arr?arr.end+4:start,end-dur),end};
 return{flight:f.code,stand:f.stand,terminal:P.terminal,door:P.door,pocket:P.id,count,travel,gap,arr,dep,points:pl};
}
function g77PolyAt(pts,d){for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++){const a=pts[i-1],b=pts[i],l=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]);if(d<=l||i===pts.length-1){const u=l?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,d/l)):0;return{x:a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*u,y:a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*u,dx:b[0]-a[0],dy:b[1]-a[1]}}d-=l}return{x:pts[0][0],y:pts[0][1],dx:0,dy:1}}
function f2BridgePassengers(t=APT_OPS.clk,flights=AO.flights){
 const out=[];
 for(const f of flights){const p=f.pax;if(!p||!f.bridge||f.bridge(t)<.99||t<f.tOB||t>=f.tPush)continue;
  for(const phase of['arr','dep']){const w=p[phase];if(!w||t<w.start||t>w.end)continue;
   const pts=phase==='arr'?p.points.slice().reverse():p.points,tot=g2PathLen(pts);   // K-72: along the bridge's line
   for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){const lt=t-w.start-i*p.gap;if(lt<0||lt>=p.travel)continue;const u=lt/p.travel,q=g77PolyAt(pts,u*tot),dx=q.dx,dy=q.dy;
    out.push({id:f.code+'-'+phase+'-'+i,flight:f.code,stand:f.stand,terminal:p.terminal,door:p.door,pocket:p.pocket,phase,asset:F2_PAX_ASSETS[i%F2_PAX_ASSETS.length],x:q.x,y:q.y,face:Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)?(dx>0?2:6):(dy>0?4:0),alpha:Math.min(1,u*14,(1-u)*14),walkTime:lt+i*.24,points:p.points})}
  }
 }
 return out;
}
// p395 · R-22: the people in the bridge at their measured size, inside the bridge's own outline
const F2_BPAX={clip:new Map(),t:-1,n:{clip:0,none:0}};   // the scale: G77_PE.sc (0.51 = 0.55 m × 7.47 px/m ÷ 8 px, the picture at scale 1)
function f2BridgeClip(stand){const t=APT_OPS.clk;if(F2_BPAX.t!==t){F2_BPAX.clip.clear();F2_BPAX.t=t}let c=F2_BPAX.clip.get(stand);if(c!==undefined)return c;c=null;
 try{const s=APT_STANDS.find(q=>q.id===stand);if(s){const f=f2BridgeFlight(s.id,t),P=g77BridgePose(s,f,f?aoBridge(s.id,t):0);if(P&&P.S){const Q=g77K72Parts(P),pa=new Path2D();
  for(const q of [Q.fixed,Q.bel1,Q.A,Q.Bt,Q.bel2,Q.cab]){if(!q||q.length<3)continue;let ar=0;for(let i=0;i<q.length;i++){const a=q[i],b=q[(i+1)%q.length];ar+=a[0]*b[1]-b[0]*a[1]}const r=ar>=0?q:q.slice().reverse();   // one turn for all: their union filled
   pa.moveTo(r[0][0],r[0][1]);for(let i=1;i<r.length;i++)pa.lineTo(r[i][0],r[i][1]);pa.closePath()}
  pa.moveTo(Q.drum.c[0]+Q.drum.r,Q.drum.c[1]);pa.arc(Q.drum.c[0],Q.drum.c[1],Q.drum.r,0,Math.PI*2);c=pa}}}catch(e){c=null}
 F2_BPAX.n[c?'clip':'none']++;F2_BPAX.clip.set(stand,c);return c}
function f2BridgeClipLine(g,P){g.beginPath();for(let k=1;k<P.length;k++){const a=P[k-1],b=P[k],dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1],len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,w=k===P.length-1?8:6,nx=-dy/len*w,ny=dx/len*w;g77PolyPath(g,[[a[0]+nx,a[1]+ny],[b[0]+nx,b[1]+ny],[b[0]-nx,b[1]-ny],[a[0]-nx,a[1]-ny]])}g.clip()}   // the old way, if the bridge has no outline
function f2DrawBridgePassengers(now,v){if(WTC_LP===1)return;
 if(!APT_OPS.ready||!portVis(v,6000,580,1230,200))return;
 const sc=G77_PE.sc;

  ctx.save();if(cl)ctx.clip(cl);else f2BridgeClipLine(ctx,p.points);ctx.globalAlpha=p.alpha;
  P34G.k=p.id??null;TurboCity.draw(ctx,p.asset,p.x-feet[1],p.y-feet[2],{mode:'runtime',scale:sc,direction:p.face,pose:'walking',time:p.walkTime});ctx.restore();
 }
 g77BcDraw(now);   /* K-157 · D-211: the flight crew through the bridge */
}

const F2_PEOPLE=[];
function f2InitPeople(){
 if(F2_PEOPLE.length)return;
 // a road crossing is the segment whose first point is flagged 'xw'/'xs'; it is entered from either end only on WALK
 f2Routes().forEach((r,i)=>{const segs=[];let tot=0;for(let k=1;k<r.pts.length;k++){const a=r.pts[k-1],b=r.pts[k],l=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]);segs.push({a,b,l});tot+=l}
  F2_PEOPLE.push({...r,segs,tot,seg:0,s:((i*97)%Math.max(1,Math.floor(tot*.8))),dir:i%2?-1:1,state:'walk',wait:0,dwell:0,hidden:false,x:r.pts[0][0],y:r.pts[0][1],face:4,crossing:false})});
 for(const p of F2_PEOPLE){let s=p.s;for(let k=0;k<p.segs.length;k++){if(s<=p.segs[k].l||k===p.segs.length-1){p.seg=k;p.s=Math.min(s,p.segs[k].l);break}s-=p.segs[k].l}
  const g=p.segs[p.seg];if(g.a[2]==='xw'||g.a[2]==='xs')p.s=p.dir>0?0:g.l;   // never start on the carriageway
  f2PlacePerson(p)}
}
function f2PlacePerson(p){const sg=p.segs[p.seg];if(!sg)return;const u=sg.l?p.s/sg.l:0;p.x=sg.a[0]+(sg.b[0]-sg.a[0])*u;p.y=sg.a[1]+(sg.b[1]-sg.a[1])*u;const dx=(sg.b[0]-sg.a[0])*p.dir,dy=(sg.b[1]-sg.a[1])*p.dir;p.face=Math.abs(dx)>=Math.abs(dy)?(dx>=0?2:6):(dy>=0?4:0)}
function f2WalkPhase(){try{const st=TrafficSignalController.ensure('AIR-2'),ph=TrafficSignalController.currentFor('AIR-2'),rem=Math.max(0,st.phaseDuration-(performance.now()-st.phaseStart))/1000;return{walk:r76WalkOk(ph,'horizontal'),rem,phase:ph.id}}catch{return{walk:false,rem:0,phase:'?'}}}
function f2PedDemand(){let n=0;for(const p of F2_PEOPLE)if(p.state==='wait-walk')n++;if(F2_PICKUP.walker&&F2_PICKUP.walker.state==='wait-walk')n++;return n}
function f2CrossingOccupied(){for(const p of F2_PEOPLE)if(p.crossing)return true;return!!(F2_PICKUP.walker&&F2_PICKUP.walker.crossing)}
function f2StepWalker(p,dt){
 if(p.dwell>0){p.dwell-=dt;if(p.dwell<=0){p.dwell=0;p.hidden=false}return}
 const sg=p.segs[p.seg];if(!sg)return;
 const atStart=p.dir>0?p.s<=0.001:p.s>=sg.l-0.001,isCross=sg.a[2]==='xw'||sg.a[2]==='xs';
 if(isCross&&atStart&&!p.crossing){const w=f2WalkPhase(),need=sg.l/p.speed+.4;if(!(w.walk&&w.rem>=need)){p.state='wait-walk';p.wait+=dt;return}p.crossing=true}
 p.state='walk';
 let mv=p.speed*dt;
 while(mv>0){const g=p.segs[p.seg];const rem=p.dir>0?g.l-p.s:p.s;if(mv<rem){p.s+=p.dir*mv;mv=0;break}
  mv-=rem;p.s=p.dir>0?g.l:0;p.crossing=false;
  const nk=p.seg+p.dir;
  if(nk<0||nk>=p.segs.length){ // end of the route: dwell (inside the terminal = hidden), then walk back
   const end=p.dir>0?g.b:g.a;p.dir=-p.dir;p.dwell=end[2]==='door'?14+((p.id.length*7)%12):5+((p.id.length*5)%7);p.hidden=end[2]==='door';p.state='dwell';mv=0;break}
  p.seg=nk;p.s=p.dir>0?0:p.segs[nk].l;
  const ng=p.segs[nk];if(ng.a[2]==='xw'||ng.a[2]==='xs')break;   // stop at the kerb: the WALK check runs next frame
 }
 f2PlacePerson(p);
}
function f2UpdatePeople(dt){if(typeof State!=='undefined'&&State.paused)return;f2InitPeople();dt=Math.min(.1,Math.max(0,dt||0));for(const p of F2_PEOPLE)f2StepWalker(p,dt);if(F2_PICKUP.walker)f2StepPickupWalker(dt)}
function f2DrawPerson(p,now){if(p.hidden)return;const moving=p.state==='walk',I=TurboCity.info(p.asset,{scale:1,direction:p.face,pose:moving?'walking':'idle'}),f=I.an.find(q=>q[0]==='Feet')||['Feet',I.w/2,I.h*.55];ctx.save();ctx.lineWidth=1;P34G.k=p.id??null;TurboCity.draw(ctx,p.asset,p.x-f[1],p.y-f[2],{mode:'runtime',scale:1,direction:p.face,pose:moving?'walking':'idle',time:moving?now/1000:0});ctx.restore()}
function f2DrawPeople(now){if(!e3InView(6000,934,1200,766,60))return;f2InitPeople();for(const p of F2_PEOPLE)f2DrawPerson(p,now);if(F2_PICKUP.walker)f2DrawPerson(F2_PICKUP.walker,now)}

const F2_CITIES=['אתונה','רומא','לרנקה','פריז','לונדון','ברלין','מדריד','וינה','פראג','בודפשט','זאגרב','סופיה','ליסבון','אמסטרדם'];
const F2_AC_NAMES={'AC-NB-01':'צר-גוף','AC-RJ-01':'סילון אזורי','AC-TP-01':'טורבו-פרופ','AC-CG-01':'מטען','AC-PR-01':'מדחף קל','AC-BJ-01':'מטוס עסקים','AC-LT-01':'דו-מנועי קל','AC-CN-01':'עסקים (כנף קדמית)','AC-AM-01':'מטוס ים','AC-TB-01':'משא (2 קורות זנב)'};
function f2City(code){let h=7;for(const c of String(code))h=(h*33+c.charCodeAt(0))>>>0;return F2_CITIES[h%F2_CITIES.length]}
function f2StateTime(f,s){const q=f.states.find(x=>x[1]===s);return q?q[0]:null}
function f2Gate(f){return f.stand}
function f2Board(now=APT_OPS.clk){
 const arr=[],dep=[];if(!APT_OPS.ready)return{arr,dep,ready:false,now};
 for(const f of AO.flights){if(f.heli||f.never||!f.states?.length)continue;const pax=/^P[1-5]$/.test(f.stand||'');if(!pax)continue;
  const inbound=f.states[0][1]==='INBOUND',tOB=f2StateTime(f,'ON_BLOCK'),tTO=f2StateTime(f,'TAKEOFF_ROLL')??f2StateTime(f,'PUSHBACK'),state=aoStateOf(f,now)||f.states[0][1];
  if(inbound&&tOB!=null&&tOB>=now-150)arr.push({code:f.code,ac:f.ac,stand:f.stand,city:f2City(f.code+'A'),t:tOB,state,landed:now>=tOB,f});
  if(tTO!=null&&tTO>=now-25&&!(inbound&&now<tOB))dep.push({code:f.code,ac:f.ac,stand:f.stand,city:f2City(f.code+'D'),t:tTO,state,f});
 }
 arr.sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t);dep.sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t);return{arr:arr.slice(0,6),dep:dep.slice(0,6),ready:true,now};
}
function f2Eta(t,now){const d=Math.round(t-now);return d>2?'בעוד '+d+' שנ׳':d>=-2?'עכשיו':'לפני '+(-d)+' שנ׳'}

 const row=(q,kind)=>[q.code+' · '+q.city,(F2_AC_NAMES[q.ac]||'')+' · שער '+q.stand+' · '+(L[q.state]||q.state)+' · '+f2Eta(q.t,B.now)];
 return pcard('נחיתות — לוח חי',B.arr.length?pkv(B.arr.map(q=>row(q,'a'))):pnote('אין כרגע נחיתות מתוכננות לעמדות הנוסעים.'),'career')
  +pcard('המראות — לוח חי',B.dep.length?pkv(B.dep.map(q=>row(q,'d'))):pnote('אין כרגע המראות מתוכננות.'),'career');
}

}
function f2StepPickupWalker(dt){
 const w=F2_PICKUP.walker,m=PlayerProfile.activeMission;if(!w)return;
 if(!m||m.id!=='M-F2-PICKUP'||m.stage==='drive'){F2_PICKUP.walker=null;return}

 const sg=w.segs[w.seg],isCross=sg.a[2]==='xw';
 if(isCross&&w.s<=0.001&&!w.crossing){const ph=f2WalkPhase(),need=sg.l/w.speed+.4;if(!(ph.walk&&ph.rem>=need)){w.state='wait-walk';return}w.crossing=true}
 w.state='walk';let mv=w.speed*dt;
 while(mv>0){const g=w.segs[w.seg],rem=g.l-w.s;if(mv<rem){w.s+=mv;mv=0;break}mv-=rem;w.s=g.l;w.crossing=false;if(w.seg>=w.segs.length-1){w.arrived=true;w.state='idle';break}w.seg++;w.s=0;if(w.segs[w.seg].a[2]==='xw')break}

function f2RetargetWalker(spaceId){const w=F2_PICKUP.walker;if(!w)return;const sp=F2_KISS_SPACES.find(s=>s.id===spaceId);if(!sp||w.space===spaceId)return;
 // only the last two segments (along the platform to the curb) change

function f2Action(action){
 const id=State.interactionId,p=APT_INTERACTIONS[id];if(!p||PlayerProfile.mode!=='walk'||Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-p.x,PlayerPed.y-p.y)>80)return false;
 if(action==='remember'&&id==='APT-SHORT'){const st=f2InsideStall(PlayerCar);if(!st||carKmh()>1)return toast('כדי לשמור מיקום, עצור את הרכב באחת מחניות P-TERM');e2Persistent().parkingLocation={x:PlayerCar.x,y:PlayerCar.y,asset:PlayerCar.asset,slot:st.id,zone:'F2',at:iso()};SaveManager.save('airport-parking-location',{backup:false,silent:true});toast('מקום החניה נשמר · '+st.id);renderPhone();return true}
 return false
}

function f2GeometryAudit(){
 aptReady();
 const issues=[],over=(a,b)=>a.x<b.x+b.w&&a.x+a.w>b.x&&a.y<b.y+b.h&&a.y+a.h>b.y,inside=q=>q.x>=6000-.01&&q.y>=850-.01&&q.x+q.w<=7200+.01&&q.y+q.h<=1700+.01;
 const roads=aptRoadRects(),fps=APT_BUILDINGS.map(aptFp),X=f2Crosswalks();
 // registry + scope
 for(const q of [...F2_STALLS,...F2_TAXI_HOLD,...F2_BUS_BAYS,...F2_KISS_SPACES,...F2_TAXI_PICK,...F2_PROPS.map(f2SpriteBox),...F2_BUILDINGS.map(aptFp)])if(!inside(q))issues.push('outside-F2:'+(q.id||q.x));
 // lots/stalls never on a road (with sidewalks), never under a building, never overlapping each other
 const lotRects=[{id:'lot',x:6088,y:1376,w:538,h:316},...F2_PLAZA_LOTS.map(L=>({id:L.id,x:L.x,y:L.y,w:L.w,h:L.h})),{id:'taxi',x:6818,y:1376,w:324,h:66},{id:'A3',...F2_A3},{id:'bus',x:6846,y:1512,w:280,h:94}];
 for(const L of lotRects){for(const r of roads)if(over(L,r))issues.push('lot-on-road:'+L.id+'/'+r.id);for(const f of fps)if(over(L,f))issues.push('lot-under-building:'+L.id+'/'+f.id)}
 const stalls=[...F2_STALLS,...F2_TAXI_HOLD,...F2_BUS_BAYS];for(let i=0;i<stalls.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<stalls.length;j++)if(over(stalls[i],stalls[j]))issues.push('stall-overlap:'+stalls[i].id+'/'+stalls[j].id);
 for(const s of F2_STALLS)for(const a of F2_AISLES)if(over(s,a))issues.push('stall-in-aisle:'+s.id);
 for(const s of F2_STALLS)if(over(s,{x:F2_WALK.x,y:F2_WALK.y,w:F2_WALK.w,h:F2_WALK.y1-F2_WALK.y}))issues.push('stall-on-walkway:'+s.id);
 for(const s of F2_STALLS)for(const W of F2_PLAZA_WALKS)if(over(s,W))issues.push('stall-on-plaza-walk:'+s.id);for(const s of F2_STALLS.filter(q=>q.plaza)){const a=F2_AISLES.find(q=>q.id===(s.lot==='P-PLAZA-W'?'PA-W':'PA-E'));if(!(s.y+s.h===a.y||s.y===a.y+a.h))issues.push('plaza-access:'+s.id)}   // GATE-74
 // parked cars fit their stall (visual clearance) and never sit in an aisle, lay-by lane or crossing
 for(const c of PARKED_CARS.filter(c=>/^PC-F2-/.test(c.id))){const I=TurboCity.info(c.asset,{scale:roadVehicleScaleFor(c.asset,c.ref)}),r=c.slotRect,vert=Math.abs(Math.sin(c.heading||0))>.5,len=I.w-4,wid=I.h-4;if(vert?(wid>r.w+1||len>r.h+1):(len>r.w+1||wid>r.h+1))issues.push('car-clearance:'+c.id)}
 // curb lay-bys: outside the through lane, inside the sidewalk band, clear of the crossings and of the stop line
 for(const L of[F2_KISS,F2_TAXI_LAYBY]){if(L.y1!==F2_RD.yN||L.y0<F2_RD.yN-46||L.y0>F2_RD.swN)issues.push(L.id+':band');if(L.y0<APT_FENCE_Y+40)issues.push(L.id+':forecourt-too-narrow');for(const c of X.all){if(c.roadId!=='F2-AIR-S'&&over({x:L.x0,y:L.y0,w:L.x1-L.x0,h:L.y1-L.y0},{x:c.x-15,y:F2_RD.yN-46,w:30,h:48}))issues.push(L.id+':crossing')}}   // S3a: terminal-side curb
 if(F2_KISS.x1>X.wx-15-50)issues.push('kiss-exit-too-close-to-stop-line');if(F2_TAXI_LAYBY.x0<X.ex+15)issues.push('taxi-entry-on-crossing');
 // signal + crossings
 if(X.all.length!==3||!X.all.every(c=>c.signalized))issues.push('air2-crossings');if(!SIGNALS.some(s=>s.node==='AIR-2'))issues.push('air2-signal');
 // pedestrians: every route point reachable and not blocked by statics (road crossings are allowed only on the zebra lines)
 for(const r of f2Routes())for(let k=1;k<r.pts.length;k++){const a=r.pts[k-1],b=r.pts[k],n=Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])/8),cross=a[2]==='xw'||a[2]==='xs';if(cross)continue;for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const x=a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*i/n,y=a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*i/n;if(y>=1157&&staticPersonBlockedAt(x,y,PLAYER_PERSON_RADIUS+.5))issues.push(r.id+':blocked@'+Math.round(x)+','+Math.round(y)+' '+staticPersonBlockedAt(x,y,PLAYER_PERSON_RADIUS+.5))}}
 for(const r of f2Routes())for(let k=1;k<r.pts.length;k++){const a=r.pts[k-1],b=r.pts[k];if(a[2]==='xw'){const near=X.all.some(c=>Math.abs(c.x-a[0])<6&&c.roadId!=='F2-AIR-S');if(!near)issues.push(r.id+':crossing-off-zebra')}if(a[2]==='xs'&&Math.abs(X.sy-a[1])>6)issues.push(r.id+':south-crossing-off-zebra')}
 for(const id of['APT-SHORT','APT-KISS','APT-TAXI','APT-BUS','APT-TERM']){const p=APT_INTERACTIONS[id];if(personBlockedAt(p.x,p.y,5))issues.push(id+':blocked-poi')}
 // props/trees/lamps never on roads, stalls, lay-bys or aisles
 const blockers=[...F2_STALLS,...F2_TAXI_HOLD,...F2_BUS_BAYS,...F2_AISLES,F2_A3,{id:'kiss',x:F2_KISS.x0,y:F2_KISS.y0,w:F2_KISS.x1-F2_KISS.x0,h:F2_KISS.y1-F2_KISS.y0},{id:'taxilane',x:F2_TAXI_LAYBY.x0,y:F2_TAXI_LAYBY.y0,w:F2_TAXI_LAYBY.x1-F2_TAXI_LAYBY.x0,h:44},...F2_CUTS.filter(q=>!/LANE$/.test(q.id)),...F2_PLAZA_WALKS];
 for(const o of F2_PROPS){const q=f2SpriteBox(o);for(const r of roads)if(over(q,r)&&q.y>1200)issues.push(o.id+':on-road');for(const b of blockers)if(over(q,b))issues.push(o.id+':blocks '+(b.id||'area'))}
 for(const o of [...F2_TREES,...F2_LAMPS]){const q={x:o.x-6,y:o.y-6,w:12,h:12};for(const r of roads)if(over(q,r))issues.push(o.id+':on-road');for(const b of blockers)if(over(q,b))issues.push(o.id+':blocks '+(b.id||'area'))}
 for(const l of STREET_LIGHTS.filter(l=>l.x>=6000&&l.x<7200&&l.y>1140&&l.y<1700)){const q={x:l.x-5,y:l.y-5,w:10,h:10};for(const b of blockers)if(over(q,b))issues.push(l.id+':blocks '+(b.id||'area'));for(const c of X.all)if(Math.hypot(c.x-l.x,c.y-l.y)<22)issues.push(l.id+':on-crossing')}
 // airside: pockets clear of stand envelopes, lane L band and buildings; make-up loops inside the gaps
 const boxes=APL.stands.filter(s=>s.tpl==='bridge').flatMap(s=>s.accepts.flatMap(ac=>aplEnv(ac,s.ngx,s.ngy,s.th).map(e=>({id:s.id,x0:e.x0,x1:e.x1,y0:e.y0,y1:e.y1})))),bld=APTT_C.bld;   // GATE-73 S2: real shapes (fuselage · wing · tail)
 for(const b of APL.bays.filter(b=>b.zone==='F2')){const hx=b.kind==='BT'?6.5:b.kind==='AB'?APTT_SPEC.veh['LV-SH-01'].fp[3]/2:F2_MS.wid/2,len0=b.kind==='BT'?F2_BAG.yc-12.7:b.y0+4,len1=b.kind==='BT'?F2_BAG.yc+53:b.y1-4,r={x0:b.x-hx,x1:b.x+hx,y0:len0,y1:len1};
  for(const s of boxes)if(r.x0<s.x1+6&&r.x1>s.x0-6&&r.y0<s.y1+6&&r.y1>s.y0-6)issues.push(b.id+':stand-envelope '+s.id);
  if(b.kind==='AB'){const Yd=G77_YARD;if(r.x0<Yd.x0||r.x1>Yd.x1||r.y1>Yd.y1||r.y0<AF.L+11+6)issues.push(b.id+':off-yard')}   // GATE-77 S5c: the bus bays in the yard
  else{if(r.y1>AF.L-11-6)issues.push(b.id+':service-road-band');if(r.y0<F2_BAG.top-48)issues.push(b.id+':too-far-north')}
  for(const q of bld)if(r.x0<q.x+q.w&&r.x1>q.x&&r.y0<q.y+q.h&&r.y1>q.y)issues.push(b.id+':building '+q.id)}
 for(const P of Object.values(F2_POCKETS)){for(const x of[P.muS,P.muN])for(const q of bld)if(x-7<q.x+q.w&&x+7>q.x&&F2_BAG.uY+8>q.y&&978<q.y+q.h)issues.push(P.mu+':lane-into-building '+q.id+'@'+x);if(P.muS-P.muN<32)issues.push(P.mu+':u-turn-tight');if(Math.min(...P.bays.map(x=>Math.abs(P.exitX-x)))<30)issues.push(P.id+':exit-lane-tight')}
 for(const s of APL.stands.filter(s=>s.bridge)){const P=f2PocketForStand(s);if(!P||s.terminal!==P.terminal||s.pocket!==P.id||f2DoorFor(s.id)!==P.door)issues.push(s.id+':terminal-binding')}
 if(Object.values(F2_POCKETS).filter(p=>!p.shared).length!==3)issues.push('expected-three-baggage-belts');
 const f2fleet=APL.fleet.filter(f=>APL.bays.find(b=>b.id===f.bay)?.zone==='F2'),bt=APL.fleet.filter(f=>f.type==='BT');
 if(f2fleet.length!==6+G2_S_BAYS.length+Object.values(F2_POCKETS).filter(p=>p.shared).reduce((a,p)=>a+p.bays.length,0))issues.push('ramp-park-fleet '+f2fleet.length);   // GATE-77 S6r · M5e: the buses of pocket S (G2_S_BAYS)   // GATE-69: MS1/MS2 live in the G2 stair parkif(bt.length!==6)issues.push('baggage-trains '+bt.length);
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:[...new Set(issues)],scope:'F2',gate:'GATE-66',terminalBindings:Object.values(F2_POCKETS).map(p=>({belt:p.id,stand:(p.stands||[p.stand]).join('+'),terminal:p.terminal,door:p.door})),parking:F2_STALLS.length,accessible:F2_STALLS.filter(s=>s.accessible).length,ev:F2_STALLS.filter(s=>s.ev).length,kissAndFly:F2_KISS_SPACES.length,taxi:F2_TAXI_PICK.length+F2_TAXI_HOLD.length,busBays:F2_BUS_BAYS.length,
  parked:PARKED_CARS.filter(c=>/^PC-F2-/.test(c.id)).length,props:F2_PROPS.length,trees:F2_TREES.length,lamps:F2_LAMPS.length,people:f2Routes().length,crossings:X.all.length,rampBays:APL.bays.filter(b=>b.zone==='F2').length,rampFleet:f2fleet.map(f=>f.id),makeUp:Object.keys(F2_POCKETS).length,next:'G1'}
}
// baggage-flow statistics of a finished sandbox simulation (called inside aptOpsQa)
function f2BagStats(T){
 const issues=[];let tasks=0,dep=0,arr=0,bags=0,f2home=0,g2home=0,remote=0;const mu={'MU-A':0,'MU-B':0,'MU-C':0};const byTerminal={T1:{arr:0,dep:0},T2:{arr:0,dep:0},T3:{arr:0,dep:0}};
 for(const v of AO.fleet){if(v.type!=='BT')continue;for(const k of v.hist.concat(v.tasks)){if(k.role!=='bag')continue;tasks++;const L=k.tr.seq.legs,kinds=L.map(l=>l.kind).join(',');
  if(k.tr.f2bag==='dep'){dep++;if(kinds!=='out,mu,mid,svc,back')issues.push('dep-legs '+v.id+' '+kinds)}else if(k.tr.f2bag==='arr'){arr++;if(kinds!=='out,svc,mid,mu,back')issues.push('arr-legs '+v.id+' '+kinds)}else issues.push('legacy-bag-task '+v.id);
  const m=L.find(l=>l.kind==='mu');if(m?.f2){mu[m.f2.mu]=(mu[m.f2.mu]||0)+1;bags+=m.f2.n;if(m.f2.remote)remote++;const P=f2PocketForStand(m.f2.sd);if(!P||P.mu!==m.f2.mu||P.terminal!==m.f2.terminal||P.door!==m.f2.door)issues.push('wrong-terminal '+v.id+' '+m.f2.sd);else byTerminal[P.door][k.tr.f2bag]++}if(v.bay.zone==='F2')f2home++;else g2home++;
  for(const l of L)if((l.kind==='mu'||l.kind==='svc')&&!(l.f2&&l.f2.fill))issues.push('no-visible-transfer '+v.id)}}
 return{ok:!issues.length&&tasks>0&&dep>0&&arr>0&&Object.values(mu).every(n=>n>0),tasks,dep,arr,bags,remote,mu,byTerminal,f2home,g2home,issues:issues.slice(0,8)};
}

// =====================================================================================================================================
// G2 · REMOTE PASSENGER STANDS P6 / P5 (GATE-69). Apron buses V-AB1/2 and mobile stairs V-MS1/2 leave their home bays in the
// service pocket S next to terminal 3, serve the aircraft at its real left (east) door and come back to the same bay.
// Every movement is a persistent-fleet task in the shared reservation table: no spawn, no fade, no overlap.
//   P6 · RJ : mobile stairs + bus      (east corridor: x 8316 north / x 8340 south, y 818 service row, U-turn east of the stand)
//   P6 · TP : the turboprop's own airstair + bus
//   P5 · TP : own airstair + bus       (alley AL2 between the maintenance hangar and hangar S1; the bus backs out of the alley)
// Order: buses and stairs are placed before the fuel truck, so passengers leave the aircraft before refuelling.
// =====================================================================================================================================
const G2_REMOTE_AC=new Set(['AC-TP-01','AC-RJ-01','AC-NB-01','AC-QJ-01']);   // GATE-77 S5b: the narrow-body at P6
const G2_REM={
 P5:{via:'AL2',x:7797,busY:862,pivot:[7797,822]},
 P6:{via:'EAST',xN:8316,xS:8340,y:818.7,uy:770,ux:8072,busX:8106,busY:818,pivotX:8110}
};
const G2_STAIR_GAP=8;
// Homes: the two apron buses stay in pocket S at terminal 3 (the bus gate), now 75 px apart so that turning in and out never sweeps a
// parked neighbour; the two mobile stairs (needed only at P6) live in the G2 stair park north of the fuel depot, on two drive-through lanes.
const G2_S_BAYS=[{id:'F2-AB1',kind:'AB',x:7165,w:24},{id:'F2-AB2',kind:'AB',x:7209,w:24},{id:'F2-AB3',kind:'AB',x:7196,w:94,yc:980,row2:1,th:Math.PI}];   // GATE-77 S6r · M5e · D-113: bus 3 (bus 4 — S6b-c, with the yards)   // GATE-77 S5c · D-84: the yard beside the tower
const G2_STAIR_PARK={x0:8190,x1:8272,lanes:[824,852,880,908],x:8230,entryX:8340,exitX:8136,label:'מדרגות ניידות · P6'};
function g2RampBays(A){
 F2_RAMP_C.bays.splice(0,F2_RAMP_C.bays.length,...G2_S_BAYS.map(b=>({...b})));
 for(let i=A.bays.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=A.bays[i];if(b.id==='F2-MS1'||b.id==='F2-MS2')A.bays.splice(i,1);if(b.id==='F2-AB2'){b.x=7209;b.x0=b.x-b.w/2;b.x1=b.x+b.w/2}}
 for(const b of G2_S_BAYS){if(!b.row2||A.bays.some(q=>q.id===b.id))continue;const hx=APTT_SPEC.veh['LV-SH-01'].fp[2]/2;A.bays.push({id:b.id,fleetId:'V-'+b.id.slice(3),kind:'AB',row:'F2',zone:'F2',pocket:'S',x:b.x,w:b.w,x0:b.x-b.w/2,x1:b.x+b.w/2,y0:b.yc-12,y1:b.yc+12,yc:b.yc,th:b.th!=null?b.th:Math.PI/2,asset:'LV-SH-01',occupied:true,idleUntil:'G2',row2:1})}   // GATE-77 S6r · M5e
 G2_STAIR_PARK.lanes.forEach((y,i)=>A.bays.push({id:'G2-MS'+(i+1),fleetId:'V-MS'+(i+1),kind:'MS',row:'G2',zone:'G2',pocket:'MS',x:G2_STAIR_PARK.x,w:70,x0:G2_STAIR_PARK.x-35,x1:G2_STAIR_PARK.x+35,y0:y-11,y1:y+11,yc:y,th:Math.PI,asset:'F2-MS',occupied:true}));s6rHSBays(A);
}   // clear of the fuselage box (reservation margin 6 px); the stair's platform reaches the door

// ==== GATE-77 S6c · p170 · AIR-64: the crew shuttle — a crew change at the remote stands ===============================================
var G77_SH={on:true,after:8,before:20,gap:.8,door:12,ok:0,skip:0,noWin:0};
// the stop at the aircraft: the departing crew out and up, then the crew that landed down and in (each group: the path at walking pace + the spacing)
function g77ShWalk(sd,ac){const P=g2PaxPath(sd,ac);let L=G77_SH.door;for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++)L+=Math.hypot(P[i][0]-P[i-1][0],P[i][1]-P[i-1][1]);return L/G77_WALK}
function g77ShHold(sd,ac){return Math.ceil(3+2*(g77ShWalk(sd,ac)+(g77ShN(ac)-1)*G77_SH.gap))}
function g77ShN(ac){const P=G77_AC[ac];const seats=(P&&P.seats)||90;return 2+Math.max(1,Math.ceil(seats/50))}
// the destination: the stand's bus stop (free between the arrival and the departure bus). P5 — the bus column x 7797 from the hardstand
// lane HW north to the stop, a turn on the spot, south down the column and east on HE home. P6 (the bus comes from the east spine) — not yet (no route from the yard rows).
function g77ShDest(sd,ac){if(!G77_SH.on)return null;const R=G2_REM[sd.id];if(R&&R.via==='EAST'&&G77_EAST.on){const SO=APL.lanes.spineOut,SI=APL.lanes.spineIn;   // GATE-77 S6c · p173 · K-127: P6 — the east spine and the bus approach
  return{spot:[R.busX,R.busY],node:afNodeEast(),inn:[[SO,R.uy,24],[R.ux,R.uy,20],[R.ux,R.busY,14],[R.busX,R.busY,0]],back:[[R.busX,R.busY,0],[8150,R.busY,12],[8150,R.uy,12],[SI,R.uy,16]]}}
 if(!R||R.via!=='AL2')return null;
 return{spot:[R.x,R.busY],node:{inX:R.x,outX:R.x+40},inn:[[R.x,1000,16],[R.x,R.busY,0]],mode:'pivot',dir:1,back:[[R.x,R.busY,0],[R.x,AF.HE,16]]}}   // turn on the spot at the stop (as the bus), south down the column, east on HE
// the walk of one crew group: the shuttle door → the passengers' path (bus stop → stairs → the aircraft door), or back

function g77ShAt(P,u){let tot=0;const seg=[];for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++){const l=Math.hypot(P[i][0]-P[i-1][0],P[i][1]-P[i-1][1]);seg.push(l);tot+=l}let d=u*tot;

// ==== GATE-77 S6c · p175 · AIR-65: FOLLOW ME (V-MX2) leads the arrivals of the remote stands ==============================================
var G77_FM={on:true,ids:['V-MX2'],st:{P5:1,P6:1},a:28,gap:14,out:8,pre:30,wMin:150,hMin:3,hMax:40,step:5,tries:4,cuts:[0,45,90,135],yLY:86,dt:.05,ok:0,skip:0,noRoom:0,late:0,why:{},diag:false,dl:[]};
function g77FmHx(){const D=s6aDimOf('MX');return D?D[0]/2:11}
// the lead leg: from the arrival leg (τ=0 at tA) — the straight lead-in, the wait point W, the launch and the peel-off
function g77FmLead(sd,ac,arr,tA,cut){const F=G77_FM,g=apttAcGeom(ac),th=sd.th,u=[Math.cos(th),Math.sin(th)],dt=F.dt,n=Math.ceil(arr.dur/dt),hx=g77FmHx();
 const X=new Float64Array(n+1),Y=new Float64Array(n+1),R=new Float64Array(n+1);
 for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const p=arr.pose(Math.min(i*dt,arr.dur));X[i]=p[0];Y[i]=p[1]}
 for(let i=n-1;i>=0;i--)R[i]=R[i+1]+Math.hypot(X[i+1]-X[i],Y[i+1]-Y[i]);
 const sx=X[n],sy=Y[n];let i0=n;
 for(let i=n;i>=0;i--){const dx=X[i]-sx,dy=Y[i]-sy,lat=Math.abs(-dx*u[1]+dy*u[0]),al=dx*u[0]+dy*u[1];if(lat>.8||al>1)break;i0=i}   // the straight lead-in, back from the stop
 const lead=g.F[1]+F.gap+hx,dN=u[1]>.9?sy-(APTT_X.LY+F.yLY):Infinity,dW=Math.min(R[i0]-lead-F.pre,dN)-(cut||0);if(dW<F.wMin)return null;   // south of taxiway L: the car never waits on it, its turn-in (W − 70) stays F.yLY − 70 px south of it
 const W=[sx-u[0]*dW,sy-u[1]*dW],xa=i=>dW-R[i],vA=i=>i<n?(R[i]-R[i+1])/dt:0,xEnd=dW+g.F[1]+F.out+hx;
 let iS=-1;for(let i=0;i<=n;i++)if(xa(i)+lead>=0){iS=i;break}if(iS<0)return null;
 for(let k=iS;k>=Math.max(0,iS-Math.round(10/dt));k--){let xf=0,vf=0,G=null,ok=true,iP=-1;const xs=[0];
  for(let i=k+1;i<=n;i++){if(G==null){vf+=F.a*dt;xf+=vf*dt;if(vf>=vA(i))G=xf-xa(i)}else xf=xa(i)+G;
   if(xf-xa(i)<lead-1e-6){ok=false;break}xs.push(xf);if(xf>=xEnd){iP=i;break}}
  if(!ok)continue;if(iP<0)return null;
  const dur=(iP-k)*dt,v1=Math.max(4,(xs[xs.length-1]-xs[xs.length-2])/dt);

  return{W,th,lead,dW,tL:tA+k*dt,tP:tA+iP*dt,dur,pose,v1}}

// the visit: the van leaves its bay so that it waits at W `hMin`…`hMax` s and pulls away exactly at the launch time
function* g77FmServeG(sd,ac,arr,tA,meta,extra){const F=G77_FM;let late=true,room=false;
 for(const cut of F.cuts){const L=g77FmLead(sd,ac,arr,tA,cut);if(!L)continue;room=true;
  for(const D of g77FmDests(sd,ac,L))for(const v of AO.fleet){if(!F.ids.includes(v.id))continue;const B0=afBuild(v,D,F.hMin,{lead:L}),sHi=Math.floor((L.tL-B0.dOut-F.hMin)/AO.DT+1e-9),sLo=Math.max(afSEarliest(),Math.ceil((L.tL-B0.dOut-F.hMax)/AO.DT-1e-9));
   for(let s=sHi,k=0;s>=sLo&&k<F.tries;s-=Math.max(1,Math.round(F.step/AO.DT)),k++){late=false;if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())yield 0;
    const B=afBuild(v,D,L.tL-aoT(s)-B0.dOut,{lead:L}),sm=(yield* aoSampG(B.trk,aoSeqLeg(B.trk.seq)));
    const s2=(yield* afSearchG(v,B.trk,sm,s,s,extra,Math.round((B.dOut+B.hold+16)/AO.DT)));if(s2!==s){const w=aoWhy(sm,s),lg=w&&B.trk.seq.legAt(w.k*AO.DT),key=(w?String(w.b).replace(/\d+/g,'#'):'busy')+'|'+(lg&&lg.leg?lg.leg.kind:'-');F.why[key]=(F.why[key]||0)+1;if(F.diag&&F.dl.length<60){const at=lg?B.trk.seq.at(w.k*AO.DT):null;F.dl.push([meta.code,sd.id,cut,key,+(aoT(s)+w.k*AO.DT-(tA+arr.dur)).toFixed(1),at?at.slice(0,2).map(Math.round):null])}continue}
    const task=afCommit(v,B.trk,sm,s,'fm',Object.assign({at:aoT(s)+B.dOut,fm:1},meta));return{t0:task.t0,end:task.t1,at:task.at,done:L.tP,v,task,L}}}}

// ==== GATE-77 S7-a · p187 · D-184: the baggage with real workers — out of the train, a chain / the belt, back on board ====================
var G77_BW={on:true,E0:.8,E1:3,stand:2.6,maxT:14,hand:{cad:.9},belt:{v:20,cad:.6},t:{lift:.25,thr:.3,hold:.3,inn:.25,place:.2},n:0};
const g77BwL=(A,B,k)=>[A[0]+(B[0]-A[0])*k,A[1]+(B[1]-A[1])*k],g77BwU=(A,B)=>{const dx=B[0]-A[0],dy=B[1]-A[1],l=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;return[dx/l,dy/l]},g77BwD=(A,B)=>Math.hypot(B[0]-A[0],B[1]-A[1]);
function g77BwBeltOf(code,t){for(const v of AO.fleet){if(v.type!=='BL')continue;for(const k of (v.hist||[]).concat(v.tasks)){if(t<k.t0||t>=k.t1||String(k.code).split('/')[0]!==code)continue;const q=k.tr.seq.legAt(t-k.t0);if(q&&q.leg.kind==='svc')return true}}return false}
function g77BwOut(a){const st=a&&a.tr&&a.lt!=null?f2BagState(a.tr,a.lt):null;return!!(st&&st.f.at==='ac'&&st.f.fill!=null)}
function g77BwTrainOn(code){if(!code)return false;const t=APT_OPS.clk;for(const v of AO.fleet){if(v.type!=='BT')continue;for(const k of v.tasks){if(t<k.t0||t>=k.t1||String(k.code).split('/')[0]!==String(code))continue;const st=f2BagState(k.tr,t-k.t0);if(st&&st.f.at==='ac'&&st.f.fill!=null)return true}}return false}
// the layout of the work: the door, the posts of the fixed workers, the stand points beside the cart slots (in the loading order)
// ap — the aircraft pose; pose — the train's (tractor) pose; carts — the cart poses; belt — the belt loader is at the hold
function g77BwLay(sd,ac,ap,pose,carts,n,belt,tr){
 const B=G77_BW,g0=apttAcGeom(ac),hw=g0.F[3],Lf=g0.nose-g0.tail,LY=s6aBagLay(sd,ac),side=s6aSide(ap,pose[0],pose[1]),cap=F2_BAG.cap,mT=B.maxT;
 let D;if(LY)D=LY.belt?LY.F:LY.door;else{const fr=S6A_HAND[ac]||S6A_BELT[ac]||.28;D=s6aAcPt(ap,g0.nose-fr*Lf,side*hw)}
 const la=s6aLocal(ap,D[0],D[1])[0],no=g77BwU(s6aAcPt(ap,la,0),D);
 const slot=idx=>{const ci=Math.min(carts.length-1,Math.floor(idx/cap)),c=carts[ci],s=idx%cap,lx=-6.2+(s%3)*4.8,ly=-2.6+(s/3|0)*5.2,cs=Math.cos(c[2]),sn=Math.sin(c[2]);
  const lp=s6aLocal(c,D[0],D[1]),sg=lp[1]>=0?1:-1,hy=(AF.cart&&AF.cart.hy)||6.5;return{p:[c[0]+lx*cs-ly*sn,c[1]+lx*sn+ly*cs],st:s6aLoc(c,lx,sg*(hy+2.4))}};
 const S=[];for(let j=0;j<n;j++)S.push(slot(n-1-j));   // loading order: the last slot first (the count on the cart goes down from the end)
 let T,M=null,mode,Pb=null,lenBF=0,Fp=null,Bp=null;
 if(belt&&LY&&LY.belt){mode='belt';Fp=LY.F;Bp=LY.B;lenBF=g77BwD(Bp,Fp);const u=g77BwU(Bp,Fp),pp=[-u[1],u[0]],c0=S[S.length-1].st,sg=((c0[0]-Bp[0])*pp[0]+(c0[1]-Bp[1])*pp[1])>=0?1:-1;
  M=[Bp[0]+pp[0]*sg*3.4,Bp[1]+pp[1]*sg*3.4];T=[Fp[0]-pp[0]*sg*3.4+u[0]*1.2,Fp[1]-pp[1]*sg*3.4+u[1]*1.2]}
 else{T=[D[0]+no[0]*B.stand,D[1]+no[1]*B.stand];let near=S[0].st;for(const q of S)if(g77BwD(q.st,T)<g77BwD(near,T))near=q.st;const d=g77BwD(near,T);
  if(d<=mT)mode='two';else{mode='three';const u=g77BwU(T,near);M=[T[0]+u[0]*Math.min(mT,d/2),T[1]+u[1]*Math.min(mT,d/2)]}}

// the schedule (loading order; unloading = the same schedule run backwards): for every bag — its cart worker (two of them take turns when
// the crew has a spare hand: belt, or by hand with a short reach), the start at the cart, the carry steps; nobody holds two bags at once
function g77BwSched(Ly,n){if(G77_BX.on)return g77BxSched(Ly,n);   /* GATE-77P · p217 · D-194 */const B=G77_BW,two=Ly.mode==='two',K=two?Ly.T:Ly.M,mT=B.maxT,wk=G77_WALK,t=B.t,cad=Ly.belt?B.belt.cad:B.hand.cad,nC=(two||Ly.belt)?2:1;
 const tail=Ly.belt?(t.hold+t.place+Ly.lenBF/B.belt.v+t.hold+t.inn):Ly.three?(t.hold+t.thr+t.hold+t.inn):(t.hold+t.inn);
 const X=[],lastOf=[null,null];
 for(let j=0;j<n;j++){const P=Ly.S[j].st,d=g77BwD(P,K),R=d<=mT?P:[K[0]+(P[0]-K[0])/d*mT,K[1]+(P[1]-K[1])/d*mT],carry=Math.max(0,d-mT)/wk,w=j%nC;let c=0;
  if(j>0){const q=X[j-1];c=Math.max(q.c+cad,q.c+q.carry-carry+t.hold+t.thr)}   // the catcher: one bag at a time
  const y=lastOf[w];if(y){const back=g77BwD(y.R,P)/wk;c=Math.max(c,y.c+t.lift+y.carry+t.thr+back)}else if(w===1)c=Math.max(c,.35);
  const x={c,P,R,carry,K,w};X.push(x);lastOf[w]=x}
 const end=X.reduce((m,x)=>Math.max(m,x.c+t.lift+x.carry+t.thr),0);return{X,tail,nC,total:X.length?end+tail:0}}
// the work at the aircraft needs (the trip planner: at the train's stop, the carts straight behind it)
function g77BwHoldAt(v,sd,ac,hold,code,e,kind){if(!G77_BW.on||!sd||!e)return hold;const n=f2BagN(code||sd.id+v.id),nc=v.bay&&v.bay.carts>2?v.bay.carts:2,cd=nc>2?G77_CD4.slice(0,nc):AF_CD;

function g77BwE(Ly,Sc,dur){const X=Sc.X,far=Math.max(g77BwD(Ly.seat,Ly.T),Ly.M?g77BwD(Ly.seat,Ly.M):0,g77BwD(Ly.seat,X[0].P),g77BwD(Ly.seat,X[X.length-1].R));return Math.max(G77_BW.E0,Math.min(G77_BW.E1,far/G77_WALK,dur/4))}
// the whole scene at one moment (the drawing and the QA)
function g77BwGeo(pose,tr,lt,carts,st,clk){if(G77_BX.on)return g77BxGeo(pose,tr,lt,carts,st,clk);   /* GATE-77P · p217 · D-194 */

    if(tau<e0+tb&&tb>.02)return{p:g77BwL(y.R,x.P,(tau-e0)/tb),face:x.P,walk:true,ph:'back'};return{p:x.P,face:x.P,walk:false,ph:'wait'}}
   if(tau<=b){if(tau<a+tt.lift)return{p:x.P,face:Ly.S[X.indexOf(x)].p,walk:false,ph:'lift'};if(tau<a+tt.lift+x.carry)return{p:g77BwL(x.P,x.R,(tau-a-tt.lift)/(x.carry||1)),face:x.R,walk:true,ph:'carry'};return{p:x.R,face:x.K,walk:false,ph:'throw'}}}

// the drawing: the bags on the carts, the workers and the bags in the work (after all the vehicles — the queue of p183)

// F9 — "כבודה: מהעגלה למטוס": the four sequences (belt / by hand × departure / arrival)
const G77_BW_LAB={beltOut:'כבודה: מסוע בהמראה — מהעגלה למטוס',beltIn:'כבודה: מסוע בנחיתה — מהמטוס לעגלה',handOut:'כבודה: טעינה ידנית בהמראה — שרשרת אל המטוס',handIn:'כבודה: טעינה ידנית בנחיתה — שרשרת אל העגלה'};
function g77BwLookAt(want,take){for(const v of AO.fleet){if(v.type!=='BT')continue;for(const k of v.tasks){if(k.role!=='bag'||!k.tr||!k.tr.seq)continue;let tt=0;for(const l of k.tr.seq.legs){if(l.kind==='svc'&&l.f2&&l.f2.at==='ac'&&l.f2.fill!=null){const code=String(k.code).split('/')[0],fl=s6aFlightOf(code);
   if(fl&&fl.sd){const LY=s6aBagLay(fl.sd,fl.ac),belt=!!(LY&&LY.belt&&g77BwBeltOf(code,k.t0+tt+l.dur/2)),m=(belt?'belt':'hand')+(l.f2.fill==='out'?'Out':'In'),W_=String(want).split('@'),st_=fl.stand+':'+fl.ac.slice(3,5);   /* GATE-77P · p230 */if(W_[1]?(st_===W_[1]&&(W_[0]===m||W_[0]==='any'+(l.f2.fill==='out'?'Out':'In'))):m===want){const p=k.tr.seq.at(tt);if(p)take(k.t0+tt-1,p[0]+(fl.sd.cx-p[0])*.35,p[1],3,G77_BW_LAB[want]||((belt?'מסוע':'ביד')+' · '+st_+' · '+(l.f2.fill==='out'?'המראה':'נחיתה')))}}break}tt+=l.dur}}}}
// QA (VQA-01, the baggage): every service leg of every train at the aircraft, sampled every 0.2 s
function g77BwAudit(all,t0,t1){const o={legs:0,samples:0,bags:0,belt:0,three:0,two:0,throwMax:0,throwDist:0,pressed:0,holdMin:1e9,holdMax:0,issues:[],ok:true},bad=m=>{if(o.issues.length<10)o.issues.push(m)};
 const save=APT_OPS.clk;try{for(const v of AO.fleet){if(v.type!=='BT')continue;for(const k of v.hist.concat(v.tasks)){if(k.role!=='bag')continue;let off=0;for(const l of k.tr.seq.legs){const L0=off;off+=l.dur;if(l.kind!=='svc'||!l.f2||l.f2.at!=='ac'||l.f2.fill==null)continue;
   const ta=k.t0+L0,tb=ta+l.dur;if(tb<t0||ta>t1)continue;o.legs++;o.holdMin=Math.min(o.holdMin,l.dur);o.holdMax=Math.max(o.holdMax,l.dur);let first=true,pv=null;   /* p217 */
   const geo=tt=>{APT_OPS.clk=tt;const lt=tt-k.t0,pose=k.tr.seq.at(lt);if(!pose)return null;const st=f2BagState(k.tr,lt);if(!st||st.f.at!=='ac')return null;const carts=[];if(k.tr.carts)for(let i=0;i<k.tr.carts.length;i++)carts.push(k.tr.cartAt(pose,i,lt,k.tr));return g77BwGeo(pose,k.tr,lt,carts,st,tt)};
   for(let tt=ta+.05;tt<tb;tt+=.2){const G=geo(tt);if(!G)continue;o.samples++;if(first){first=false;o[G.mode]++;if(G.k>1.02){o.pressed++}}
    for(const b of G.bags){o.bags++;const w=b.w!=null?G.W[b.w]:null;
     if(b.s==='lift'){if(!w||g77BwD(b.p,w.p)>13.5)bad('BAG-OUT-OF-REACH '+v.id+' '+G.st+' @'+tt.toFixed(1))}
     else if(b.s==='hand'){if(!w||g77BwD(b.p,w.p)>3.2)bad('BAG-NO-HAND '+v.id+' '+G.st+' @'+tt.toFixed(1))}
     else if(b.s==='throw'){const d=b.d,dt=b.dt/(G.k||1);o.throwMax=Math.max(o.throwMax,+dt.toFixed(2));o.throwDist=Math.max(o.throwDist,+d.toFixed(1));if(dt>.45||d>18)bad('LONG-THROW '+v.id+' '+G.st+' '+d.toFixed(1)+'px '+dt.toFixed(2)+'s');
      for(let i=0;i<G.W.length;i++){if(i===b.a||i===b.z)continue;if(g77BwD(b.p,G.W[i].p)<1.2)bad('THROUGH-PERSON '+v.id+' '+G.st)}}}if(G77_BX.on){pv=g77BxCheck(o,G,pv,tt,v.id,bad,geo(tt-1/30),geo);if(Math.abs(tt-(ta+tb)/2)<.1&&G.k>1.02)o.pressedMid=(o.pressedMid||0)+1}}   /* p219 */   /* GATE-77P · p217 */
   const G=geo(tb-1e-3);if(G&&G77_BX.on){const Ge=geo(tb-G.E-1e-6);if(Ge&&(Ge.out?(Ge.onTrain!==0||!Ge.bags.every(b=>b.s==='door')):(Ge.onTrain+Ge.bags.length!==Ge.n||!Ge.bags.every(b=>b.s==='lift')))){o.bx=o.bx||{};o.bx.end=(o.bx.end||0)+1;bad('END '+v.id+' '+Ge.st+' '+(Ge.out?'out':'in')+' on the cart '+Ge.onTrain+'/'+Ge.n)}}   /* p217 */if(G)for(const w of G.W)if(w.k!=='top'&&g77BwD(w.p,G.seat)>.8)bad('NOT-BACK '+v.id+' '+G.st+' '+w.k)}}}}
 finally{APT_OPS.clk=save}if(o.holdMin===1e9)o.holdMin=0;o.holdMin=+o.holdMin.toFixed(1);o.holdMax=+o.holdMax.toFixed(1);o.ok=!o.issues.length&&o.legs>0;return o}

// ==== GATE-77 S7-a · p188 · a vehicle parked in its bay is an obstacle in the reservation search ===================================
var G77_IH={on:true,dye:true,hit:0,jump:0,last:false,until:0,F:null,nF:0,R:null};
function g77IhRows(){if(G77_IH.R&&G77_IH.F===AO.fleet&&G77_IH.nF===AO.fleet.length)return G77_IH.R;
 const by={};for(const w of AO.fleet){const q=[];apttShapes(w.tr0,w.home,q);if(!q.length)continue;let x0=1e9,x1=-1e9,y0=1e9,y1=-1e9;for(const b of q){x0=Math.min(x0,b.x0);x1=Math.max(x1,b.x1);y0=Math.min(y0,b.y0);y1=Math.max(y1,b.y1)}
  const key=w.bay&&w.bay.row||'_',G=by[key]||(by[key]={x0:1e9,x1:-1e9,y0:1e9,y1:-1e9,h:[]});G.h.push({v:w,id:w.id,q,x0,x1,y0,y1});G.x0=Math.min(G.x0,x0);G.x1=Math.max(G.x1,x1);G.y0=Math.min(G.y0,y0);G.y1=Math.max(G.y1,y1)}
 G77_IH.F=AO.fleet;G77_IH.nF=AO.fleet.length;return G77_IH.R=Object.values(by)}
// idle at t: no task covers t (afPose / afShapes use the same rule) → the slice at which the idle stretch ends (its next task), or -1 when busy
function g77IhIdleTo(w,t){let nx=Infinity;for(const k of w.tasks){if(t>=k.t0&&t<k.t1)return -1;if(k.t0>t&&k.t0<nx)nx=k.t0}return nx}
function g77IhHit(a,s){if(!G77_IH||!G77_IH.on||!AO.fleet)return false;const L=a.L;if(L==='S'||L==='R'||L==='A'||!(a.x0<=a.x1))return false;
 const m=AO.M,R=g77IhRows();let t=null;
 for(const G of R){if(a.x0>G.x1+m||a.x1<G.x0-m||a.y0>G.y1+m||a.y1<G.y0-m)continue;
  for(const h of G.h){if(h.id===a.t||a.x0>h.x1+m||a.x1<h.x0-m||a.y0>h.y1+m||a.y1<h.y0-m)continue;
   let hit=false;for(const b of h.q)if(aoC(a,b)){hit=true;break}if(!hit)continue;
   if(t==null)t=aoT(s);const nx=g77IhIdleTo(h.v,t);if(nx<0)continue;
   G77_IH.hit++;G77_IH.last=true;G77_IH.w=AO.work;G77_IH.until=nx===Infinity?s+4000:Math.max(s+1,aoSlUp(nx));return true}}
 return false}
// P4 (the large stand, the trains of pocket D beside its east edge): the approach lane yA follows the aircraft's hold (sd.ngy+H-39) and
// for some types it runs 4 px in front of the noses of the trains parked in the D bays (7182 / 7202) — the lane keeps clear of them:
// never south of the parked noses − the widest part (cart, 6.5) − AO.M − 1 (≈ 563.5).  Route only (the train turns a few px further north).
function g77DyE(){if(!G77_IH||!G77_IH.dye)return Infinity;const P=F2_POCKETS.D;let yc=null,hx=12.7;
 if(typeof AO!=='undefined'&&AO.fleet)for(const v of AO.fleet)if(v.bay&&v.bay.zone==='F2'&&v.bay.pocket==='D'){yc=yc==null?v.bay.yc:Math.min(yc,v.bay.yc);if(v.tr0&&v.tr0.hx)hx=v.tr0.hx}

// ==== GATE-77 S7-a · p189 · K-130: the baggage train under a bridge arm / a wing is drawn as a silhouette ==========================

// the covered parts of the moving baggage trains at clock t: [{v, part (OBB), cover}]
function g77SilParts(t,C){const out=[];if(!AO.fleet)return out;

function g77SilPoly(g,a){const c=a.c,s=a.s,X=[1,-1,-1,1],Y=[1,1,-1,-1];g.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const x=a.x+c*a.hx*X[i]-s*a.hy*Y[i],y=a.y+s*a.hx*X[i]+c*a.hy*Y[i];i?g.lineTo(x,y):g.moveTo(x,y)}g.closePath()}

  g.restore()}

// QA (offline): every second a moving train is covered, and the silhouette path finds a part for it

// ==== GATE-77 S7-a · p190 · the departure train loads at the end of the main loader's stay when the push comes later ===============

// ==== GATE-77 S7-a · p191 · AIR-55 / QA-63: the big flight board at the terminal entrances ========================================

function g77FidsAirline(f){if(!f)return'';if(/^AC-(PR|BJ|LT|CN|AM)/.test(f.ac||''))return'תעופה כללית';return G77_FIDS_AL[(g77Livery(f)%16)%8]}

function g77FidsBoarding(f){const p=f.pax&&f.pax.dep;if(p&&p.start!=null)return[p.start,p.end];

function g77FidsStatus(f,kind,now){

// the rows at clock `now`: {arr:[...], dep:[...]} — the passenger stands P1–P6, the next G77_FIDS.rows of each, by time
function g77FidsRows(now=APT_OPS.clk,flights=AO.flights){const arr=[],dep=[];if(!flights)return{arr,dep,now,ready:false};

  const inbound=f.states[0][1]==='INBOUND',ob=g77FidsT(f,'ON_BLOCK'),push=g77FidsT(f,'PUSHBACK')??g77FidsT(f,'TAXI_OUT'),to=g77FidsT(f,'TAKEOFF_ROLL');
  const base={code:f.code,ac:f.ac,stand:f.stand,airline:g77FidsAirline(f),f};
  if(inbound&&ob!=null&&ob>=now-120)arr.push(Object.assign({kind:'arr',city:f2City(f.code+'A'),t:ob,ts:g77FwSchedA(f,ob),st:g77FidsStatus(f,'arr',now)},base));
  if(push!=null&&to!=null&&to>=now-60&&!(inbound&&ob!=null&&now<ob))dep.push(Object.assign({kind:'dep',city:f2City(f.code+'D'),t:push,ts:g77FwSchedD(f,push),st:g77FidsStatus(f,'dep',now)},base))}

// QA (offline, in a run): every 10 s — each row's status agrees with its flight's state, the gate is the stand, rows by time, phone = board
function g77FidsAudit(t0,t1){const o={samples:0,rows:0,arr:0,dep:0,st:{},issues:[],ok:true},bad=m=>{if(o.issues.length<8)o.issues.push(m)};
 const all=(AO.hist||[]).concat(AO.flights);   // the run is over: the departed flights are in the history
 for(let t=t0+30;t<t1;t+=10){const B=g77FidsRows(t,all);o.samples++;
  for(const [kind,list] of [['arr',B.arr],['dep',B.dep]]){let prev=-Infinity;
   for(const q of list){o.rows++;o[kind]++;o.st[q.st]=(o.st[q.st]||0)+1;const f=q.f,s=aoStateOf(f,t)||f.states[0][1];
    if(q.t<prev-1e-6)bad('ORDER '+kind+' '+q.code+' @'+t);prev=q.t;
    if(q.stand!==f.stand)bad('GATE '+q.code);
    if(q.st==='dep'&&!['TAKEOFF_ROLL','DEPARTED'].includes(s)&&!(t>=f.t1))bad('DEP '+q.code+' '+s+' @'+t);
    if(q.st==='gone'&&!['PUSHBACK','TAXI_OUT','HOLD_SHORT','RUNWAY_RESERVED','LINE_UP'].includes(s))bad('GONE '+q.code+' '+s+' @'+t);
    if(q.st==='landed'&&['INBOUND','APPROACH','LANDING_RESERVED','GO_AROUND'].includes(s))bad('LANDED '+q.code+' '+s+' @'+t);
    if(q.st==='board'&&!['ON_BLOCK','TURNAROUND_READY','PUSHBACK_RESERVED'].includes(s))bad('BOARD '+q.code+' '+s+' @'+t);
    if(!q.airline)bad('AIRLINE '+q.code);if(q.ts==null||q.ts>q.t+1e-6)bad('SCHED '+q.code)}}}
 o.ok=!o.issues.length;return o}
