function g77TvRwy(f){if(f.rwy)return f.rwy;const t=g77TvT(f,'LANDING_ROLL')??g77TvT(f,'TAKEOFF_ROLL');if(t==null)return'09';for(const q of f.tracks||[]){if(q.tr.kind!=='ac')continue;const p=q.tr.seq.at(t-q.t0+1);if(p)return Math.cos(p[2])>=0?'09':'27'}return'09'}
// the requests of the flights at clock `now`: one per (flight, kind) between its ask and its ready + the miss window
function g77TvCards(now,flights=g77TvFl(now),done={}){const out=[];
 for(const f of flights||[]){if(f.heli||f.never||!(f.states&&f.states.length))continue;
  for(const k in G77_TV_KIND){const K=G77_TV_KIND[k],ta=g77TvT(f,K.ask),tr=g77TvT(f,K.ready);if(ta==null||tr==null||tr<ta-1e-6)continue;const id=(f.uid||f.code)+':'+k;if(done[id])continue;
   if(now<ta||now>tr+G77_TV.miss)continue;
   const al=f.al!=null?f.al:typeof g77FidsAirline==='function'?g77FidsAirline(f):'',where=k==='taxiin'?' '+f.stand:k==='push'?' מ-'+f.stand:'',rw=K.rwy?g77TvRwy(f):'';
   const hint=k==='land'?f.code+' בגישה — מבקש נחיתה במסלול '+rw+'. המסלול פנוי?':k==='taxiin'?f.code+' פינה את המסלול — מבקש הסעה לעמדה '+f.stand+'. הדרך פנויה?':k==='push'?f.code+' מוכן בעמדה '+f.stand+' — מבקש דחיפה. הגורר והדרך מאחוריו פנויים?':k==='taxiout'?f.code+' נדחף — מבקש הסעה לנקודת ההמתנה.':k==='lineup'?f.code+' בנקודת ההמתנה — מבקש כניסה למסלול '+rw+'. אין נחיתה ואין המראה?':f.code+' על המסלול '+rw+' — מבקש אישור המראה. המסלול לפניו פנוי?';
   out.push({id,f,k,name:K.name+where,btn:K.btn,ask:ta,ready:tr,airline:al,hint})}}
 out.sort((a,b)=>a.ready-b.ready);return out}
// the controller's reason why it is not safe yet (the real state at `now`)
function g77TvWhy(c,now){const K=G77_TV_KIND[c.k],dt=Math.max(1,Math.round(c.ready-now));let s=null;try{s=c.f.s15?g77TvS15Rwy(now,c.f):f1Snapshot(now)}catch(e){}
 if(K.rwy&&s&&s.owners&&s.owners.length&&!s.owners.includes(c.f.code)){const o=s.owners[0],ph=typeof F1_PHASE_LABELS!=='undefined'&&F1_PHASE_LABELS[s.phase]?F1_PHASE_LABELS[s.phase]:s.phase;return'המסלול תפוס: '+o+' ('+ph+'). הבקר משחרר בעוד '+dt+' שנ׳.'}
 if(c.k==='push'||c.k==='taxiout'||c.k==='taxiin')return'דרך ההסעה עדיין בשימוש — הבקר משחרר בעוד '+dt+' שנ׳.';
 if(c.k==='takeoff')return'עוד לא — המטוס מתיישר על המסלול ('+dt+' שנ׳).';
 return'עוד לא בטוח — מרווח בטיחות; הבקר משחרר בעוד '+dt+' שנ׳.'}
// ---- the mission ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function g77TvState(){const m=PlayerProfile.activeMission;return m&&m.id==='M-F1-TOWER'?m:null}
function g77TvStart(d){   /* missions 11.11 (R26‑7.4 / R26‑8): לחיצה אחת, מכל מקום — המגדל של S15 בתוך אגף השערים, השחקן לא מגיע אליו ברגל */
 PlayerProfile.activeMission={id:d.id,stage:'tower-view',reward:d.reward,timeRemaining:d.timeLimit,startedAt:iso(),startCollisions:PlayerCar.collisions||0,returnVehicle:null,
  tv:{correct:0,errors:0,misses:0,holds:0,score:0,resp:[],done:{},held:{},log:[]}};
 SaveManager.save('mission-start',{backup:true,silent:true});
 if(State.phoneOpen)try{setPhoneOpen(false)}catch(e){}g77TvEnter(false);toast('משמרת הבקרה התחילה · אשר כשבטוח, ״המתן״ כשלא');return true}
function g77TvResume(m){m.tv||={correct:0,errors:0,misses:0,holds:0,score:0,resp:[],done:{},held:{},log:[]};m.tv.done={};m.tv.held={};g77TvEnter(false)}
function g77TvEnter(brief){G77_TV.on=true;G77_TV.saved={x:Camera.x,y:Camera.y,zoom:Camera.zoom};State.mapQa=true;State.mapOpen=false;try{setMapOpen(false)}catch(e){}Input.held.clear();
 const B=G77_TV.bounds;G77_TV.zFit=Math.max(.18,Math.min(innerWidth/(B.x1-B.x0),innerHeight/(B.y1-B.y0)));Camera.x=(B.x0+B.x1)/2;Camera.y=(B.y0+B.y1)/2;Camera.zoom=G77_TV.zFit;
 G77_TV.brief=!!brief;G77_TV.sel=null;try{updateMapQaButton()}catch(e){}g77TvRender()}
function g77TvExit(){if(!G77_TV.on)return;G77_TV.on=false;State.mapQa=false;const a=playerActor();Camera.x=a.x;Camera.y=a.y;if(G77_TV.saved)Camera.zoom=G77_TV.saved.zoom;G77_TV.brief=false;try{updateMapQaButton()}catch(e){}g77TvRender()}
function g77TvClamp(){const B=G77_TV.bounds;Camera.zoom=Math.max(G77_TV.zFit,Math.min(G77_TV.zMax,Camera.zoom));const hw=innerWidth/2/Camera.zoom,hh=innerHeight/2/Camera.zoom;
 Camera.x=(B.x1-B.x0)<=2*hw?(B.x0+B.x1)/2:Math.max(B.x0+hw,Math.min(B.x1-hw,Camera.x));Camera.y=(B.y1-B.y0)<=2*hh?(B.y0+B.y1)/2:Math.max(B.y0+hh,Math.min(B.y1-hh,Camera.y))}
function g77TvMsg(t,kind){G77_TV.msg={t,kind:kind||'info'};G77_TV.msgT=performance.now()}
function g77TvAct(id,what){const m=g77TvState();if(!m||G77_TV.brief)return;const now=g77TvNow(),c=g77TvCards(now,g77TvFl(now),m.tv.done).find(q=>q.id===id);if(!c)return;const T=m.tv,safe=now>=c.ready-G77_TV.early;
 if(what==='ok'){if(!safe){T.errors++;T.score-=40;T.log.push({id,k:c.k,t:+now.toFixed(1),r:'blocked'});g77TvMsg('נחסם: '+g77TvWhy(c,now)+' (טעות · ‎−40)','err')}
  else{const rt=Math.max(0,now-c.ready);T.correct++;T.resp.push(+rt.toFixed(1));const pts=Math.max(40,100-Math.round(rt*4));T.score+=pts;T.done[id]=1;T.log.push({id,k:c.k,t:+now.toFixed(1),r:'ok',rt:+rt.toFixed(1)});g77TvMsg('✓ '+c.name+' — '+c.f.code+' (+'+pts+')','ok');
   if(T.correct>=G77_TV.target)return g77TvFinish(true)}}
 else{if(!safe){if(!T.held[id]){T.held[id]=1;T.holds++;T.score+=10;g77TvMsg('נכון — '+c.f.code+' ממתין. '+g77TvWhy(c,now)+' (+10)','ok')}else g77TvMsg(c.f.code+' כבר ממתין.','info')}
  else g77TvMsg('עכשיו זה בטוח — הבקר פינה את הדרך ל-'+c.f.code+'. אשר.','info')}
 G77_TV.sel=id;g77TvRender()}
function g77TvTick(dt){const m=g77TvState();if(!m){if(G77_TV.on)g77TvExit();return}if(!G77_TV.on)g77TvEnter(false);g77TvClamp();if(G77_TV.brief){g77TvRender(true);return}
 m.timeRemaining=Math.max(0,m.timeRemaining-dt);const now=g77TvNow(),T=m.tv;
 for(const c of g77TvCards(now,g77TvFl(now),T.done))if(now>c.ready+G77_TV.miss-.05){T.done[c.id]=1;T.misses++;T.score-=20;T.log.push({id:c.id,k:c.k,t:+now.toFixed(1),r:'miss'});g77TvMsg('המפקח אישר במקומך: '+c.name+' — '+c.f.code+' (‎−20)','err')}
 if(m.timeRemaining<=0)return g77TvFinish(false);g77TvRender(true)}
function g77TvFinish(ok){const m=g77TvState();if(!m)return;const T=m.tv,avg=T.resp.length?+(T.resp.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/T.resp.length).toFixed(1):null;
 const p=PlayerProfile.worldPersistent.towerShifts||(PlayerProfile.worldPersistent.towerShifts={runs:0,best:null,last:null});p.runs++;p.last={at:iso(),ok,score:T.score,correct:T.correct,errors:T.errors,misses:T.misses,avg};if(ok&&(p.best==null||T.score>p.best))p.best=T.score;
 G77_TV.sum={ok,score:T.score,correct:T.correct,errors:T.errors,misses:T.misses,holds:T.holds,avg,reward:ok?MISSION_DEFS['M-F1-TOWER'].reward:0};G77_TV.sumT=performance.now();
 g77TvExit();if(ok)missionComplete();else missionFail('timeout');g77TvRender()}

function g77TvLook(){if(PlayerProfile.activeMission&&!g77TvState())return'יש משימה אחרת פעילה';if(g77TvState()){G77_TV.brief=false;g77TvRender();return'המשמרת פעילה'}const p=APT_INTERACTIONS['APT-TOWER'];PlayerProfile.mode='walk';PlayerPed.x=p.x;PlayerPed.y=p.y+6;if(State.mapQa)State.mapQa=false;return startMission('M-F1-TOWER')?'משמרת בקרה — תדריך':'לא התחיל'}
// QA (offline, after a run): every card has a ready time inside its flight's states; an eager controller (approves on sight) is
// blocked on every early approval with a reason; a perfect controller (approves at ready) makes 0 errors
function g77TvAudit(t0,t1){const all=g77TvS15()?(()=>{const a=[];for(let n=Math.floor(t0/S15SIM.T)-1;n<=Math.floor(t1/S15SIM.T)+1;n++)a.push(...g77TvS15Cyc(n));return a})():(AO.hist||[]).concat(AO.flights),o={cards:0,byKind:{},early:0,blockedWithWhy:0,perfectErrors:0,issues:[],ok:true},seen={};

// the schedule (the loading frame; unloading runs it backwards): two cart workers take turns; the belt foot / the meeting point — one at a time

  for(let i=0;i<mine.length;i++){const x=mine[i],thS=fa(x.P,x.sp),thW=x.carry>1e-6?walkTh(x.P,x.R):thS,thT=fa(x.R,tgt);
   if(tau<x.f0+x.back&&x.from&&x.back>1e-6)return{p:g77BwL(x.from,x.P,(tau-x.f0)/x.back),th:walkTh(x.from,x.P),walk:true,ph:'back',cr:false};

  const x=mine[mine.length-1];return{p:x.R,th:fa(x.R,tgt),walk:false,ph:'done',cr:false}};

  for(const x of J){if(tau<x.ps){const toR=fa(p,x.R);th=last?g77BxAng(thD,toR,(tau-last.d1)/X.turn):toR;break}
   if(tau<x.pe){th=fa(p,x.R);break}

// VQA-01 (p217): at every sample — the bag on the cart / in a hand / on the belt / at the door, never in the air; continuity between samples
function g77BxCheck(o,G,pv,tt,id,bad,Gp,geo){const X=G77_BX,tag=id+' '+G.st+' '+(G.out?'out':'in')+' '+G.mode,cur=new Map();o.bx=o.bx||{throw:0,face:0,passGap:0,jump:0,wjump:0,appear:0,vanish:0,count:0,end:0};

  if(b.s==='hand'&&b.w!=null&&G.W[b.w]){const w=G.W[b.w],a=Math.atan2(b.p[1]-w.p[1],b.p[0]-w.p[0]),da=Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(a-w.th),Math.cos(a-w.th)));if(da>X.face){o.bx.face++;bad('FACING '+tag+' '+(da*57.3|0)+'°')}}

  if(b.s==='pass'&&G.W[b.a]&&G.W[b.z]){const A=G.W[b.a],Z=G.W[b.z],ha=[A.p[0]+Math.cos(A.th)*X.hand,A.p[1]+Math.sin(A.th)*X.hand],hz=[Z.p[0]+Math.cos(Z.th)*X.hand,Z.p[1]+Math.sin(Z.th)*X.hand];if(g77BwD(ha,hz)>X.passGap){o.bx.passGap++;bad('PASS-GAP '+tag+' '+g77BwD(ha,hz).toFixed(1)+'px')}}}

function g77HebRaw(t){const M=G77_HEB.map;if(M[t]!=null)return M[t];if(!/[A-Za-z]/.test(t))return t;   /* p350: the map first · p360: any Latin letter (a zone code like G2 has no two in a row) */

function g77HebQa(){const o={ok:false,places:0,words:0,english:[],codes:0};const P=CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype,f0=P.fillText,seen=new Map();

 try{P.fillText=function(t,...a){const s=String(t);if(/[A-Za-z]{3}/.test(s)&&!/[֐-׿]/.test(s))seen.set(s,(seen.get(s)||0)+1);o.words++;return f0.call(this,t,...a)};
  State.mapQa=true;WTC.budgetMs=1e9;if(typeof FS!=='undefined')FS.budgetMs=1e9;
  for(const [x,y,z] of spots){Camera.x=x;Camera.y=y;Camera.zoom=z;try{wtcInvalidate()}catch(e){}const now=performance.now();for(let i=0;i<2;i++)render(now);o.places++}}
 catch(e){o.error=String(e&&e.message||e)}finally{P.fillText=f0;Camera.x=sv.x;Camera.y=sv.y;Camera.zoom=sv.z;State.mapQa=sv.mq;WTC.budgetMs=sv.b;if(typeof FS!=='undefined')FS.budgetMs=sv.fb;try{wtcInvalidate()}catch(e){}}

function g77PassPlayerCar(v,c,lane,dt){

// ==== GATE-77P · p247 · D-193 (ב): the make-up belt carries the train's own bags; one colour per bag; no jumps ====================
var G77_MUB={on:true,speed:20,n:0};
function g77MubColor(n,j){return F2_BAG_COLORS[((n||0)*7+j*3)%F2_BAG_COLORS.length]}
// the bags of a make-up leg at the leg's time: [{j,x,y,th,c,where:'belt'|'slide'|'cart'}]
function g77MubBags(st,carts){const f=st.f,n=f.n|0,T=f2BagTimes(st.leg.dur,n),t=st.t,cap=F2_BAG.cap,out=[],sp=G77_MUB.speed,xb=f.beltX-4.5,y0=F2_BAG.belt0+1,y1=F2_BAG.belt1-1,load=f.fill==='in';
 for(let j=0;j<n;j++){const ci=Math.min(carts.length-1,Math.floor(j/cap)),c=carts[ci];if(!c)continue;const slot=j%cap,lx=-6.2+(slot%3)*4.8,ly=-2.6+(slot/3|0)*5.2,cs=Math.cos(c[2]),sn=Math.sin(c[2]),px=c[0]+lx*cs-ly*sn,py=c[1]+lx*sn+ly*cs;
  const yb=Math.max(y0,Math.min(y1,py)),ride=(yb-y0)/sp,s0=T.t0+j*T.step,fl=Math.max(T.fly,Math.hypot(px-xb,py-yb)/38),s=load?s0+T.fly-fl:s0,e=load?s0+T.fly:s0+fl,col=g77MubColor(n,j),th=c[2];   /* p406: a long slide — loading: it starts earlier and reaches the cart as scheduled; unloading: it leaves the cart as scheduled and reaches the belt later */
  if(load){if(t<s-ride)continue;
   if(t<s){out.push({j,x:xb,y:y0+(t-(s-ride))*sp,th,c:col,where:'belt'});continue}
   if(t<e){const u=(t-s)/fl;out.push({j,x:xb+(px-xb)*u,y:yb+(py-yb)*u,th,c:col,where:'slide'});continue}
   out.push({j,x:px,y:py,th,c:col,where:'cart'})}
  else{if(t<s){out.push({j,x:px,y:py,th,c:col,where:'cart'});continue}
   if(t<e){const u=(t-s)/fl;out.push({j,x:px+(xb-px)*u,y:py+(yb-py)*u,th,c:col,where:'slide'});continue}
   if(t<e+ride)out.push({j,x:xb,y:yb-(t-e)*sp,th,c:col,where:'belt'})}}
 return out}
function g77MubBag(g,x,y,th,c){g.save();g.translate(x,y);g.rotate(th);g.fillStyle='rgba(8,18,26,.4)';g.fillRect(-1.6,-1.1,4.3,3.9);g.fillStyle=c;g.fillRect(-2.1,-1.8,4.3,3.9);g.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.38)';g.fillRect(-2.1,-1.8,4.3,.9);
 g.fillStyle='#14181c';g.fillRect(-.7,-2.5,1.4,.8);g.strokeStyle='rgba(20,24,28,.6)';g.lineWidth=.4;g.strokeRect(-2.1,-1.8,4.3,3.9);g.restore()}
function g77MubDraw(g,carts,al,st){G77_MUB.n++;g.save();g.globalAlpha=al;for(const b of g77MubBags(st,carts))g77MubBag(g,b.x,b.y,b.th,b.c);g.restore();return true}

function g77BcWin(f){const p=f.pax;if(!p||!f.bridge||!p.points)return null;const C=g77CrewN(f.ac),n=C.p+C.fa,G=p.gap,o={n,C,arr:null,dep:null,last:null};

 return o}
function g77BcList(t){const out=[];if(!G77_BC.on||typeof AO==='undefined'||!AO.flights)return out;

  const pts=p.points,tot=g2PathLen(pts),put=(t0,P,i,pilot)=>{const lt=t-t0;if(lt<0||lt>=p.travel)return;const u=lt/p.travel,q=g77PolyAt(P,u*tot);out.push({f,i,pilot,x:q.x,y:q.y,th:Math.atan2(q.dy,q.dx),al:Math.min(1,u*14,(1-u)*14),pts})};
  if(W.arr!=null){const P=pts.slice().reverse();for(let i=0;i<W.n;i++)put(W.arr+i*p.gap,P,i,i>=W.n-W.C.p)}   /* the cabin crew, then the pilots */
  if(W.dep!=null){for(let i=0;i<W.k;i++)put(W.dep+i*p.gap,pts,i,i<W.C.p);if(W.last!=null)put(W.last,pts,W.n-1,false)}}   /* the pilots first */
 return out}

function g77OtMetrics(R){const M={},put=(k,v,dir)=>{if(v!=null&&Number.isFinite(+v))M[k]=[+(+v).toFixed(2),dir]};

function g77OtKeyHe(k){const p=k.split('.'),N=G77_OT_NAME,U={fps:'FPS',p95:'p95 (ms)',p99:'p99 (ms)',o100:'פריימים מעל 100ms',max:'הפריים הארוך (ms)',open:'פתיחה — הארוכה מ-5 (ms, מידע)',close:'סגירה — הארוכה מ-5 (ms, מידע)',openMed:'פתיחה — חציון של 5 (ms)',closeMed:'סגירה — חציון של 5 (ms)',first:'פתיחה ראשונה (ms)',ops:'פעולות ציור לפריים',mpx:'מיליון פיקסלים לפריים'};
 if(p[0]==='seg')return(N[p[1]]||p[1])+' · '+(U[p[2]]||p[2]);if(p[0]==='gd')return'ציור · '+(N[p[1]]||p[1])+' · '+(U[p[2]]||p[2]);if(p[0]==='ui')return(N[p[1]]||p[1])+' · '+(U[p[2]]||p[2]);
 if(p[0]==='bench')return'Benchmark '+(PERF_MODE_HE[p[1]]||p[1])+' · '+p[2]+' · '+(U[p[3]]||p[3]);
 return{'save.manual':'שמירה ידנית — קיפאון (ms)','save.auto':'שמירה אוטומטית — קיפאון (ms)','load':'טעינה — קיפאון (ms)','load.total':'טעינה — עד שהמשחק ממשיך (ms)','save.kb':'גודל השמירה (KB)','boot.smooth':'פתיחה עד שאפשר לשחק (ms)','boot.restore':'פתיחה מחדש בסוף הבדיקה (ms)','mem.heap':'זיכרון JS — בפתיחה, בקירוב של Chrome (MB, מידע)','mem.cmb':'תמונות — המרבי (MB)','hidden.back':'חזרה מחלון מוסתר — הפריים הארוך (ms)','long.fps':'ריצה ארוכה · FPS ממוצע','long.p95':'ריצה ארוכה · p95 ממוצע (ms)','long.o100':'ריצה ארוכה · פריימים מעל 100ms','long.heapEnd':'ריצה ארוכה · זיכרון JS בסוף (MB, מידע — בקירוב של Chrome)'}[k]||k}

function g77OtCompare(M,P,R,H){const rows=[],NZ=g77OtNoise(H),reA=new Set(R?g77OtRe(R):[]),reB=new Set(P.re||G77_OT_RE0[P.date]||[]),mA=R?g77OtMeta(R):{},mB=P.meta||null;   /* D-220 · p277 */
 const taxiOk=()=>{const a=mA.taxi,b=mB&&mB.taxi;if(!a||!b||a.dest!==b.dest||a.x0==null||b.x0==null)return false;return Math.hypot(a.x0-b.x0,a.y0-b.y0)<=40};   /* D-225 · p296: the destination and the start */
 for(const [k,[v,dir]] of Object.entries(M)){const q=P.m&&P.m[k];if(!q)continue;const p=q[0];const floor=/^(save|load|boot)/.test(k)?20:/o100$/.test(k)?2:/\.(ops)$/.test(k)?20:/mpx$/.test(k)?.1:2;
  const g=g77OtGrp(k),n=NZ.N[k],thr=Math.max(10,n!=null?n:15),info=/^ui\.\w+\.(open|close)$/.test(k)||/^(mem\.heap|long\.heapEnd)$/.test(k);   /* D‑604: Chrome בלי דגל מוסר את ה-JS מעוגל, מהקריאה הראשונה (בפתיחה, עם זבל שעוד לא נאסף) ומעדכן אותו פעם ב-20 דק׳ — מידע, לא החמרה */let nc=null;if(g==='seg.taxi'&&!taxiOk())nc='המונית לא יצאה מאותה נקודה לאותו יעד';else if(/^ui\./.test(k)&&!!mA.uiw!==!!(mB&&mB.uiw))nc='הממשק נמדד מעכשיו אחרי שהמצלמה חזרה אל השחקן (p326); לפני — המעבר היה בתוך הפתיחה הראשונה';else if(g&&reA.has(g)!==reB.has(g))nc='באחת הריצות הקטע נמדד שוב (על מטמונים חמים)';
  if(!(p>0)){rows.push({k,p,v,pct:null,thr,nc,info,reg:!nc&&!info&&dir<0&&v-p>=floor});continue}const worse=(dir>0?(p-v)/p:(v-p)/p)*100,big=Math.abs(v-p)>=floor;
  rows.push({k,p,v,pct:Math.round((v-p)/p*100),thr,nc,info,reg:!nc&&!info&&big&&worse>thr,better:!nc&&!info&&big&&worse<-thr,noise:!nc&&!info&&big&&Math.abs(worse)>10&&Math.abs(worse)<=thr})}
 return{build:P.build,date:P.date,rows,reg:rows.filter(r=>r.reg),better:rows.filter(r=>r.better),noise:rows.filter(r=>r.noise),nc:rows.filter(r=>r.nc&&!r.info)}}

// ==== 27.10 · p321 · the owner 25.10 14:04 + 18:03: close pictures of every zone, drawn by the game itself (R26 · WDA-01) ====
// The camera goes over the whole map in a grid (overlap 18%, the zoom of the owner's example 2.85 — or 2 for a faster run), one picture of
// every zone, and one picture centred on every place where a road crosses from one zone to the next.  The simulation is paused and the
// autosave is off for the whole run: the game state does not change (the saves are checked before and after).  Every picture goes to the
// browser's own storage (IndexedDB 'turbo_city_zones', not the saves) as soon as it is taken — nothing is kept in memory, a run that was
// cut can continue where it stopped.  At the end: ZIP files of up to 24 MB (index.html + index.json in the first), downloaded by a button.
var G77_ZONES={on:true,lv:{hi:2.85,fast:2},overlap:.18,q:.82,type:'image/webp',ext:'webp',partMB:24,minMs:350,maxMs:7000,stable:6,
 key:'turbo_city_zs_run',dbName:'turbo_city_zones',busy:false,abort:false,run:null,cv:null,crcT:null,dbP:null,estS:1.2,estKB:50};
function g77ZnCrc(u8){let T=G77_ZONES.crcT;if(!T){T=G77_ZONES.crcT=new Uint32Array(256);for(let n=0;n<256;n++){let c=n;for(let k=0;k<8;k++)c=c&1?0xEDB88320^(c>>>1):c>>>1;T[n]=c>>>0}}
 let c=0xFFFFFFFF;for(let i=0;i<u8.length;i++)c=T[(c^u8[i])&255]^(c>>>8);return (c^0xFFFFFFFF)>>>0}
function g77ZnDb(){if(G77_ZONES.dbP)return G77_ZONES.dbP;G77_ZONES.dbP=new Promise(res=>{try{const r=indexedDB.open(G77_ZONES.dbName,1);
 r.onupgradeneeded=()=>{const db=r.result;if(!db.objectStoreNames.contains('shots'))db.createObjectStore('shots')};r.onsuccess=()=>res(r.result);r.onerror=()=>res(null)}catch(e){res(null)}});return G77_ZONES.dbP}
function g77ZnTx(mode,fn){return g77ZnDb().then(db=>new Promise(res=>{if(!db)return res(null);try{const tx=db.transaction('shots',mode),st=tx.objectStore('shots');let out=null;const r=fn(st);
 if(r)r.onsuccess=()=>{out=r.result};tx.oncomplete=()=>res(out);tx.onerror=tx.onabort=()=>res(null)}catch(e){res(null)}}))}
function g77ZnPut(k,v){return g77ZnTx('readwrite',st=>st.put(v,k))}
function g77ZnKeys(){return g77ZnTx('readonly',st=>st.getAllKeys())}
function g77ZnAll(id){return g77ZnTx('readonly',st=>st.getAll(IDBKeyRange.bound(id+'|',id+'|￿')))}
function g77ZnClearOther(id){return g77ZnTx('readwrite',st=>{const r=st.openCursor();r.onsuccess=()=>{const c=r.result;if(!c)return;if(String(c.key).split('|')[0]!==String(id))c.delete();c.continue()};return null})}
function g77ZnSave(R){try{localStorage.setItem(G77_ZONES.key,JSON.stringify(R))}catch(e){}}
function g77ZnLoad(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(G77_ZONES.key)||'null')}catch(e){return null}}
function g77ZnZones(){return MAP_CHUNKS.map(c=>({id:c.id,x:c.x,y:c.y,w:c.w,h:c.h,name:c.name||c.title||c.label||''}))}
function g77ZnZoneAt(Z,x,y){for(const c of Z)if(x>=c.x&&x<c.x+c.w&&y>=c.y&&y<c.y+c.h)return c;return null}
// ---- the plan: the zone pictures, the grid over the whole map, the border pictures, and the check that no part of a zone is left out ----
function g77ZnPlan(lv){const Z=g77ZnZones(),W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight,zg=G77_ZONES.lv[lv]||G77_ZONES.lv.hi,ov=G77_ZONES.overlap,S=[];
 for(const c of Z)S.push({n:c.id+'_all',k:'zone',x:Math.round(c.x+c.w/2),y:Math.round(c.y+c.h/2),z:+(Math.min(W/c.w,H/c.h)*.95).toFixed(3),zones:[c.id],p:c.id});
 const X0=Math.min(...Z.map(c=>c.x)),X1=Math.max(...Z.map(c=>c.x+c.w)),Y0=Math.min(...Z.map(c=>c.y)),Y1=Math.max(...Z.map(c=>c.y+c.h)),vw=W/zg,vh=H/zg;
 const fit=(L,v)=>{if(L<=v)return[1,0];const n=Math.ceil((L-v)/(v*(1-ov)))+1;return[n,(L-v)/(n-1)]},[nc,sx]=fit(X1-X0,vw),[nr,sy]=fit(Y1-Y0,vh),G=new Map();
 for(let r=0;r<nr;r++)for(let q=0;q<nc;q++){const x0=X0+q*sx,y0=Y0+r*sy,R={x:x0,y:y0,w:vw,h:vh},zs=Z.filter(c=>c.x<R.x+R.w&&c.x+c.w>R.x&&c.y<R.y+R.h&&c.y+c.h>R.y);if(!zs.length)continue;
  const cx=x0+vw/2,cy=y0+vh/2;let pz=g77ZnZoneAt(Z,cx,cy);if(!pz){let best=-1;for(const c of zs){const o=(Math.min(c.x+c.w,R.x+R.w)-Math.max(c.x,R.x))*(Math.min(c.y+c.h,R.y+R.h)-Math.max(c.y,R.y));if(o>best){best=o;pz=c}}}
  const s={n:pz.id+'_g'+String(r).padStart(2,'0')+'_'+String(q).padStart(2,'0'),k:'grid',x:+cx.toFixed(1),y:+cy.toFixed(1),z:zg,zones:zs.map(c=>c.id),p:pz.id,r,c:q};S.push(s);G.set(r*1000+q,s)}
 const B=[];try{const N=new Map(NODES.map(n=>[n.id,n]));for(const e of EDGES){const a=N.get(e.a),b=N.get(e.b);if(!a||!b)continue;const n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y)/8));
  let prev=g77ZnZoneAt(Z,a.x,a.y),px=a.x,py=a.y;for(let i=1;i<=n;i++){const x=a.x+(b.x-a.x)*i/n,y=a.y+(b.y-a.y)*i/n,cz=g77ZnZoneAt(Z,x,y);
   if(prev&&cz&&cz!==prev){const mx=(x+px)/2,my=(y+py)/2,pair=[prev.id,cz.id].sort().join('-');if(!B.some(o=>o.pair===pair&&Math.hypot(o.x-mx,o.y-my)<300))B.push({pair,x:Math.round(mx),y:Math.round(my),road:e.name||e.id})}
   if(cz)prev=cz;px=x;py=y}}}catch(e){}
 const cnt={};for(const o of B){cnt[o.pair]=(cnt[o.pair]||0)+1;S.push({n:'B_'+o.pair+'_'+cnt[o.pair],k:'border',x:o.x,y:o.y,z:zg,zones:o.pair.split('-'),p:o.pair.split('-')[0],road:o.road})}
 // coverage: every 20 px cell of every zone must lie whole inside one grid picture
 const cell=20,tol=.5;let tot=0,cov=0;const miss=[],inside=(s,x,y,x1,y1)=>s&&x>=s.x-vw/2-tol&&x1<=s.x+vw/2+tol&&y>=s.y-vh/2-tol&&y1<=s.y+vh/2+tol;
 for(const c of Z)for(let y=c.y;y<c.y+c.h;y+=cell)for(let x=c.x;x<c.x+c.w;x+=cell){tot++;const x1=Math.min(x+cell,c.x+c.w),y1=Math.min(y+cell,c.y+c.h);
  const qa=sx?Math.max(0,Math.ceil((x1-X0-vw)/sx-1e-9)):0,qb=sx?Math.min(nc-1,Math.floor((x-X0)/sx+1e-9)):0,ra=sy?Math.max(0,Math.ceil((y1-Y0-vh)/sy-1e-9)):0,rb=sy?Math.min(nr-1,Math.floor((y-Y0)/sy+1e-9)):0;let ok=false;
  for(let r=ra;r<=rb&&!ok;r++)for(let q=qa;q<=qb&&!ok;q++)ok=inside(G.get(r*1000+q),x,y,x1,y1);if(ok)cov++;else if(miss.length<50)miss.push([c.id,x,y])}
 return{lv,zg,vw:Math.round(vw),vh:Math.round(vh),W,H,dpr:devicePixelRatio||1,ov,nc,nr,shots:S,cov:{tot,cov,pct:+(100*cov/tot).toFixed(3),miss},
  count:{zone:S.filter(s=>s.k==='zone').length,grid:S.filter(s=>s.k==='grid').length,border:S.filter(s=>s.k==='border').length},zones:Z,bbox:[X0,Y0,X1,Y1]}}

function g77ZnSig(){const w=WTC.stats,a=[w.built,w.fallbackTiles,w.syncBuilt];try{a.push(SBC.stats.made)}catch(e){}try{a.push(PORT_CACHE_MEM.made)}catch(e){}return a.join(',')}
async function g77ZnSettle(s){const raf=()=>new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(r)),t0=performance.now();let st=0,last=null,n=0;
 for(;;){Camera.x=s.x;Camera.y=s.y;Camera.zoom=s.z;await raf();n++;const g=g77ZnSig();if(g===last)st++;else{st=0;last=g}const t=performance.now()-t0;
  if(t>=G77_ZONES.minMs&&st>=G77_ZONES.stable&&n>=4)return{ms:Math.round(t),ok:true};if(t>G77_ZONES.maxMs)return{ms:Math.round(t),ok:false}}}
async function g77ZnShot(s,R){const src=GAME_CTX.canvas,d=devicePixelRatio||1,fs=Math.round(13*d),strip=Math.round(fs*2.6),c=G77_ZONES.cv||(G77_ZONES.cv=window.document.createElement('canvas'));
 if(c.width!==src.width||c.height!==src.height+strip){c.width=src.width;c.height=src.height+strip}
 const x=c.getContext('2d');x.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);x.fillStyle='#0b1620';x.fillRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);x.drawImage(src,0,0);
 const t1=s.n+' · '+(s.k==='zone'?'האזור כולו':s.k==='border'?'גבול בין אזורים':'רשת')+' · אזורים: '+s.zones.join(', ')+(s.road?' · '+s.road:''),
  t2='x '+Math.round(s.x)+' · y '+Math.round(s.y)+' · זום '+s.z+' · '+g77OtShort(BUILD)+' · '+R.stamp;
 x.font='600 '+fs+'px "Segoe UI",Arial';x.direction='rtl';x.textAlign='right';x.fillStyle='#ffe08a';x.fillText(t1,c.width-fs*.7,src.height+fs*1.1);
 x.fillStyle='#cfe0ee';x.font=fs+'px "Segoe UI",Arial';x.fillText(t2,c.width-fs*.7,src.height+fs*2.25);
 const blob=await new Promise(r=>c.toBlob(r,G77_ZONES.type,G77_ZONES.q));if(!blob)throw new Error('התמונה לא נוצרה');const buf=new Uint8Array(await blob.arrayBuffer());
 return{blob,crc:g77ZnCrc(buf),size:buf.length}}

async function g77ZnStart(o={}){if(G77_ZONES.busy){toast('צילומי האזורים כבר רצים');return null}if(!o.auto&&(G77_OT.lock||PERF.busy)){toast('בדיקה אחרת רצה');return null}
 G77_ZONES.busy=true;G77_ZONES.abort=false;G77_OT.lock=true;const sv={mq:State.mapQa,pa:State.paused,x:Camera.x,y:Camera.y,z:Camera.zoom,asv:G77_ASV.on!==false};
 let R=null;const old=g77ZnLoad();if(o.resume&&old&&old.build===BUILD&&!old.done)R=old;
 if(!R){const P=g77ZnPlan(o.lv||'hi');if(o.only){const f=new Set(o.only);P.shots=P.shots.filter(s=>f.has(s.p)||f.has(s.n))}if(o.max)P.shots=P.shots.slice(0,o.max);
  const t=new Date();R={v:1,id:Date.now(),build:BUILD,lv:P.lv,at:t.toISOString(),stamp:g77OtStamp(t),plan:P,done:false,n:0,bytes:0,fails:[],slow:[],auto:!!o.auto,ms:0,settleMs:0};await g77ZnClearOther(R.id)}
 G77_ZONES.run=R;g77ZnSave(R);g77ZnPanel();let fp0=null;try{fp0=await g77OtFp()}catch(e){}
 try{G77_ASV.on=false}catch(e){}try{G77_WL.hold=true;await g77WakeOn()}catch(e){}
 State.mapQa=true;State.paused=true;try{Input.held.clear()}catch(e){}
 const have=new Set(((await g77ZnKeys())||[]).map(String)),t0=performance.now();let i=0;
 try{for(const s of R.plan.shots){i++;if(G77_ZONES.abort)break;const key=R.id+'|'+s.n;if(have.has(key))continue;
   const st=await g77ZnSettle(s);R.settleMs+=st.ms;let out=null;try{out=await g77ZnShot(s,R)}catch(e){R.fails.push(s.n+': '+e.message);continue}
   if(!st.ok)R.slow.push(s.n);const ok=await g77ZnPut(key,{n:s.n,blob:out.blob,crc:out.crc,size:out.size,ms:st.ms,ok:st.ok});
   if(ok===null){R.fails.push(s.n+': השמירה בדפדפן נכשלה');if(R.fails.length>5){G77_ZONES.abort=true;break}continue}
   R.n++;R.bytes+=out.size;if(R.n%5===0)g77ZnSave(R);g77ZnProgress(R,i,performance.now()-t0)}}
 finally{R.ms+=Math.round(performance.now()-t0);State.paused=sv.pa;State.mapQa=sv.mq;
  if(!sv.mq){try{const a=playerActor();Camera.x=a.x;Camera.y=a.y}catch(e){Camera.x=sv.x;Camera.y=sv.y}}else{Camera.x=sv.x;Camera.y=sv.y}Camera.zoom=sv.z;
  try{G77_ASV.on=sv.asv;g77AsvReset()}catch(e){}try{G77_WL.hold=false;g77WakeOff()}catch(e){}G77_OT.lock=false;G77_ZONES.busy=false}
 let fp1=null;try{fp1=await g77OtFp()}catch(e){}R.savesKept=fp0&&fp1?Object.keys(fp0).every(k=>fp0[k]===fp1[k]):null;R.done=!G77_ZONES.abort;R.endAt=new Date().toISOString();g77ZnSave(R);
 await g77ZnEnd(R);return R}

function g77ZnDl(R,parts,i){const enc=new TextEncoder(),files=parts[i].map(r=>({name:r.n+'.'+G77_ZONES.ext,blob:r.blob,crc:r.crc,size:r.size}));

function g77ZnZip(files){const enc=new TextEncoder(),out=[],cd=[],d=new Date();let off=0;const dt=((d.getFullYear()-1980)<<9)|((d.getMonth()+1)<<5)|d.getDate(),tm=(d.getHours()<<11)|(d.getMinutes()<<5)|(d.getSeconds()>>1);
 for(const f of files){const nm=enc.encode(f.name),h=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(30));h.setUint32(0,0x04034b50,true);h.setUint16(4,20,true);h.setUint16(6,0x0800,true);h.setUint16(8,0,true);h.setUint16(10,tm,true);h.setUint16(12,dt,true);
  h.setUint32(14,f.crc,true);h.setUint32(18,f.size,true);h.setUint32(22,f.size,true);h.setUint16(26,nm.length,true);h.setUint16(28,0,true);out.push(h.buffer,nm,f.blob);
  const c=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(46));c.setUint32(0,0x02014b50,true);c.setUint16(4,20,true);c.setUint16(6,20,true);c.setUint16(8,0x0800,true);c.setUint16(10,0,true);c.setUint16(12,tm,true);c.setUint16(14,dt,true);
  c.setUint32(16,f.crc,true);c.setUint32(20,f.size,true);c.setUint32(24,f.size,true);c.setUint16(28,nm.length,true);c.setUint32(42,off,true);cd.push(c.buffer,nm);off+=30+nm.length+f.size}
 let cl=0;for(const x of cd)cl+=x.byteLength;const e=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(22));e.setUint32(0,0x06054b50,true);e.setUint16(8,files.length,true);e.setUint16(10,files.length,true);e.setUint32(12,cl,true);e.setUint32(16,off,true);
 return new Blob(out.concat(cd,[e.buffer]),{type:'application/zip'})}

// ==== D-220 (1) · the airport restore of a load in parts, with a progress screen (p266) ============================================
var G77_LDS={on:true,syncMs:400,sliceMs:120,bgOn:true,bgMs:10,sync:0,job:null,n:0,stats:{loads:0,sliced:0,bg:0,maxSyncMs:0,lastMs:0,lastSlices:0,lastBg:0}};   /* D-220 · p283: bgOn, bgMs */
function* g77LdsSteps(exact,A,t0,t1){if(exact){const p0=Math.ceil(A.t0),pe=A.done?A.pt:A.pt-1;for(let t=p0;t<=pe;t++)yield t;AO.pt=pe>=p0?pe:null}else{for(let t=t0;t<t1;t+=1)yield t;yield t1}}
function g77LdsTotal(exact,A,t0,t1){if(exact){const p0=Math.ceil(A.t0),pe=A.done?A.pt:A.pt-1;return Math.max(1,pe-p0+1)}let n=0;for(let t=t0;t<t1;t+=1)n++;return n+1}
// in one piece (ms = Infinity: QA, Benchmark) — the loop as it was; in parts — every step planned in slices exactly as the running
// game plans it (g77DetTick: aoStep(t) again until AO.stepDone === t; AO.sliced / useClock on), the deadline of a call = the end of
// this part.  A single step of the planner can take seconds (the first one after aoInit: 3.8 s at the owner's moment), so the parts
// are cut inside the steps, not between them.
function g77LdsRun(J,ms){const one=!isFinite(ms),end=performance.now()+ms,sl=AO.sliced,uc=AO.useClock,cm=AO.cfg.ms;G76X.ovr=J.ovr;G76X.ofs0=J.ovr;
 try{if(one){AO.sliced=false;AO.useClock=false;AO.workLimit=Infinity}else{AO.sliced=true;AO.useClock=true}
  for(;;){if(J.cur==null){const r=J.it.next();if(r.done){J.done=true;break}J.cur=r.value;J.calls=0}
   if(!one)AO.cfg.ms=Math.max(1,end-performance.now());
   aoStep(J.cur);J.calls++;
   if(one||AO.stepDone===J.cur||J.calls>50000){if(J.calls>50000)J.stuck=(J.stuck||0)+1;J.cur=null;J.n++}
   if(performance.now()>=end)break}}
 finally{AO.sliced=sl;AO.useClock=uc;AO.cfg.ms=cm;G76X.ofs=G76X.ofs0=G76X.ovr;G76X.ovr=null}return J.done}
function g77LdsFinish(J){APT_OPS.clk=J.t1;APT_OPS.last=null;const C=G77_CONT;C.ms=performance.now()-J.w0;C.last={clk:J.t1,seed:J.A.seed,from:J.t0,ms:Math.round(C.ms),exact:!!J.exact,pt:AO.pt};if(J.sliced)C.last.sliced=J.slices;
 G77_LDS.stats.lastMs=Math.round(C.ms);G77_LDS.stats.lastSlices=J.slices||0;try{Dbg.event('airport-e1','continuity-load',C.last)}catch(e){}return C.last}

function g77PoleBest(x,y,occ,acc=false,gap=20,ns=false){   /* p365: acc — clearCurbPoint skips the access bands */const E=EDGES,n=E.length,lb=new Float64Array(n),ix=new Array(n),W=g77Bw();W.refit++;

// the drawing functions of a layer, in order: the calls of the layer function one by one (read from the function itself, each made a small

  for(const st of b.split(';').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean)){if(/[{}]/.test(st)||!/^[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\(/.test(st)){out=null;break}const f=eval('(function(now){'+st+'})');out.push([f,true,st.slice(0,st.indexOf('('))])}}

// ==== D-225 · p296: the taxi of the owner tests — the same side of the road, moved along it until the place is free ====
function g77TaxiSide(car,e,q){const L=Math.max(1,e.len||Math.hypot((e.x2||0)-(e.x1||0),(e.y2||0)-(e.y1||0))||400),dt=18/L,body={id:car.id,asset:car.asset,ref:car.ref||'Sedan'};

  if(!hit||hit==='PLAYER-PED')return{dirSign:q.dirSign,t,p,d:Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-p.x,PlayerPed.y-p.y),moved:k}}
 return null}
